lines.en: We feed you only for the Face of God - we desire from you no repayment, and no thanks.
The intention of the believer is better than his deed.
lines.source: The Messenger of God ﷺ - al-Kafi

lines.en: Some deeds stay pure the way secrets stay secrets: untold.
They are Fatima, her father, her husband, and her sons.
I did not create a built sky... except for the love of these Five beneath the cloak.
lines.source: His word to the angels - Hadith al-Kisa

lines.en: The sky you have lived your whole life under was raised for the five beneath that cloak.
Patience upon Your decree, O my Lord. There is no god but You.
lines.source: Imam al-Husayn - Maqtal al-Husayn of al-Muqarram

lines.en: I complain of my anguish and my grief only to God.
Patience has three stations: to endure the decree, to accept it, to find peace within it.
Our intercession will not reach one who takes the prayer lightly.
lines.source: Imam Ja'far al-Sadiq - al-Amali of al-Saduq

lines.en: Prostrate - and draw near.
You have never once prayed unanswered - He answers the Fatiha line for line.
I praise God with the best of praise, and I thank Him in ease and in hardship.
Now you have thanked Me - now that you know that even the thanks is from Me.
Thanks is the one debt that grows by being paid.
When the truth was put on trial, God reached not for a sword but for a purified family.
One word - purified - travels from Maryam's prayer-niche to the five beneath the cloak.
I love not those that set.
A heart made for God can chase the setting lights its whole life and never once feel held.
There was never a second pile: a whole life, prayer to final breath, turned one direction.
And you did not throw when you threw, but Allah threw.
Badr was won before the first arrow: the victory was God's to give.
When the outcome was never yours to carry, you are free to pour yourself out completely.
You said yes once, before you can remember; your life is the second time you are asked.
They walked in as Pharaoh's hired magicians at sunrise; before sunset they were martyrs.
Pride, heedlessness, or a slow letting-go: every fall in al-A'raf is one promise slipping.
I have submitted to the Lord of all the worlds.
The cow God asked for was free; the cow their questions built cost its weight in gold.
Obedience was always the shortest road; only our questions ever made it long.
This is between Me and My servant - and My servant shall have what he asked.
The prayer God taught you to pray, He answers: the asking and the giving are one motion.
Al-Fatiha ends with a plea, guide us - and the very next page of the Qur'an is the answer.
Indeed, it is We who sent down the Reminder, and indeed, it is We who will guard it.
Gracious forgiveness is pardon without reproach.
The surah says 'secure' twice: on walls carved into rock, and at a door He opens in peace.
Hud and its sisters have grayed me.
The same surah that grayed the Prophet was built, story by story, to steady his heart.
Fear needs a second power. Hud counted the powers in the world and came to one.
A good word is like a good tree: its root is firm, and its branch reaches into the sky.
I am the prayer of my father Ibrahim.
What is planted with God in dead ground is never wasted; it grows while you are gone.
Truly, We have given you al-Kawthar.
God answered the cruelest taunt with a daughter, and through her line filled the earth.
The abundance may already be in your house, in a form the world has not learned to count.
He whose mawla I am - whose guardian and master I am - this Ali is his mawla.
This day I have perfected for you your religion, and completed My favor upon you...
You renew the oldest pledge every time you stand to pray: we hear, and we obey.
From the furthest star to the water in your throat: one hand.
The One who will not let the bird drop for a single moment is the One holding you.
Al-Mulk at night sends ahead the one voice that will still speak when yours has stopped.
Taste this, Ali - taste the fire. This is for the one who fails the widow and the orphan.
A right on a page protects no one; every right is a trust placed in someone's hands.
Obedience closes the distance that love alone cannot close.
Truly, in the remembrance of Allah do hearts find rest.
I am the warner, and Ali is the guide after me.
The foam rides loud on the flood, and it goes; what benefits people remains in the earth.
None of Your favors, my Lord, do I deny.
Guidance was prepared before you existed, the way a cradle is made ready before a birth.
Everything passes; what remains is not a cold survivor but generosity that stays.
Before you ever turned toward God, He had already turned toward you.
The one who repents of a sin is as one with no sin at all.
Every road away from God turns, and leads back into His mercy.
People are asleep, and when they die they wake.
"Peace" - a word from a Merciful Lord.
An awake heart runs toward the truth; it never quite learned how to walk.
My servant keeps drawing near to Me with voluntary acts until I love him...
Pharaoh did not run out of mercy; he ran out of moments when a yes could mean anything.
Only one city ever turned in time; this surah carries its prophet's name as the proof.
No blame upon you today. May God forgive you, and He is the most merciful of the merciful.
Beautiful patience is the certainty that God keeps an account no darkness can erase.
Every pit was a road; from the well to the throne, not one hour was wasted.
Whoever feared Me in the world, I make him secure on the Day of Resurrection.
A little deed with taqwa is worth more than a great deal without it.
Taqwa is not the size of what you do - it is what you refuse when no one would know.
O God, You are my trust in every distress, and my hope in every hardship.
And when you have resolved, rely upon God. Indeed God loves those who rely.
Trust placed in Him, not in the outcome, cannot be broken by the outcome.
I saw nothing but beauty.
lines.source: Sayyida Zaynab - al-Luhuf of Ibn Tawus

lines.en: And worship your Lord until certainty comes to you.
Certainty has three depths: to know the fire by its smoke, to see it, to stand within it.

gems.en: Every remedy traces back to Him - no created hand holds independent power to lift an affliction.
When He intends good for you, nothing in existence can turn it away - His bounty has no repeller.
His giving follows His wisdom, not the world's expectations - mercy lands where He wills it.
The verse states His power, then closes in His mercy - the Forgiving, the Merciful holds both.

morning.en: Whatever touches you today is already sorted by the verse: harm only He removes, good none can block.

night.en: Whatever hurt today has only one remover - and He ends the verse as the Forgiving, the Merciful.

gems.en: The truth came clear and from your Lord - it stands on its own, needing no outside proof.
Every guided step is banked for your own soul - and straying charges no account but your own.
Even the Prophet was no manager over belief - conveying was his role; the choosing stays yours.

morning.en: The truth has already arrived from your Lord - what remains of today is what you do with it.

night.en: The truth that reached you today was for your soul's own benefit - every guided step is yours to keep.

gems.en: Amid the day's noise His invitation does not pause - it stays extended, waiting on your answer.
The destination is named Peace itself - a home where conflict, anxiety, and suffering end.
Guidance is offered wide and received by the seeking - a heart kept open is your part of the path.

morning.en: Whatever today holds, one invitation stands over it: Allah calls to the Home of Peace.

night.en: The day's noise fades; the invitation does not. The Home of Peace is still being offered tonight.

gems.en: He does not repay good exactly - He adds beyond what was earned. Grace outruns the ledger.
The 'extra' many scholars read as beholding their Lord - a reward above all of Paradise's delights.
No darkness, no humiliation on those faces - goodness done here becomes radiance there.
Paradise is a residence, not a visit - a home held forever, with no fear of losing it.

morning.en: Do good today and the promise is not proportion but surplus: the best reward, and extra.

night.en: Today's good enters the verse's arithmetic: the best reward, and extra - in a home that never ends.

gems.en: 'Allah does not wrong the people at all' - no punishment unearned, no reward unfairly withheld.
The only harm that reaches a soul is self-chosen - His guidance stands; turning away is the injury.
Guidance given, choice free, consequences owned, judgment just - the whole account is fair.

morning.en: One certainty to carry today: whatever goes wrong, no wrong will ever come from Him.

night.en: Whatever went wrong today, one thing is settled: none of it was injustice from Him. He wrongs no one.

gems.en: Sun radiant, moon reflective - two lights with two distinct roles, arranged for your benefit.
The moon's phases are a calendar hung in the sky - time was made measurable for life and worship.
All of it was created in truth - the sky is purpose and wisdom, not decoration or accident.
The signs are detailed 'for a people who know' - the sky rewards reflection, not just a glance.

morning.en: The sun lighting today was made a light on purpose - and the moon was set in phases you can count on.

night.en: The moon out tonight is keeping count, phase by phase, exactly as He determined - nothing above is aimless.

gems.en: The counsel is from your Lord - instruction from the One who made the heart it addresses.
The Qur'an is healing for what sits in the chest - doubt, despair, and the heart's quieter diseases.
It shows the path and supplies strength to walk it - guidance and mercy travel as a pair.
It calls all humanity, but opens fully to faith - met with belief, it gives guidance and mercy.

morning.en: What reaches you from the Qur'an today is four gifts at once: counsel, healing, guidance, mercy.

night.en: Whatever the day left sitting in your chest, healing for exactly that has already been sent down.

gems.en: The awliya of Allah are those drawn near to Him - and nearness carries His standing protection.
No fear ahead, no grief behind - closeness to Him quiets both directions of worry.

morning.en: The verse describes a reachable life: close to Him, no fear of what comes, no grief for what passed.

night.en: If today drew you nearer to Him, you shared something of His friends' rest: no fear, and no grief.

gems.en: The response to success is set - glorify and praise Him, and humility keeps its ground.
Istighfar belongs even to victory - the best day's work still leans on His covering mercy.
Tawwab is a repeated acceptance - the door of return does not close after one use.
'Your Lord' - through every phase, the Prophet was nurtured, guided, and sustained personally.

morning.en: Should today succeed, the response is already written: exalt Him with praise, and ask His forgiveness.

night.en: End the day the way the Qur'an ends victories - praise, then istighfar, before the Ever-Accepting.

gems.en: Ahad shuts every door to division - one in essence, attributes, and acts, without partner or part.
'Say' marks the words as given - His oneness is declared in words He Himself taught.
Huwa - He - names a real, personal Lord; not a force or an idea, but the One who is.
Ahad outreaches 'one' - not first in a series, but beyond comparison with anything at all.

morning.en: The day's simplest, largest sentence is given to you: say, He is Allah, One.

night.en: The day ends at the deen's root - He is Allah, One; nothing met today compares with Him.

gems.en: 'Remain on a right course' weighed even on the Prophet - steadiness is the heaviest, worthiest work.
The command was given to a company, not one man - believers hold the line by holding each other.
'Do not transgress' guards the other edge - even zeal for the good must keep its balance.
He is Seeing of what you do - the steady steps and the slips both register with Him.

morning.en: Today's assignment is steadiness: remain on course as commanded, without drift and without excess.

night.en: One more day on the course - and He was Seeing of all of it, the unnoticed steady steps included.

gems.en: Patience is commanded right where faith gets hard - endurance is part of the work, not a delay.
Every good deed sits on record - nothing done well today can slip out of His keeping.
Muhsinin means more than doing good - it is doing it beautifully, as if seeing Him watching.

morning.en: Carried into today's efforts: Allah does not let the reward of those who do good be lost.

night.en: Nothing good you did today was lost - His keeping of the doers of good does not drop a single deed.

gems.en: Each messenger's account was related on purpose - the Qur'an's stories are aimed at your faith.
Even the Prophet's heart was made firm through these accounts - making firm is their stated purpose.
Within the stories came the truth itself - about prophethood, justice, and what we answer for.
The accounts give most to believers - received in faith, reading becomes reminder.

morning.en: The stories in the Qur'an are not history lessons - they were sent to make hearts firm, yours included.

night.en: If today shook you, the remedy is old and stated: accounts sent down to make the heart firm again.

gems.en: All that is hidden - in the heavens, the earth, and this day - is His domain, completely known.
Every matter, all of it, returns to Him - no loose end of your life resolves anywhere else.
Worship follows logically - the One who holds all knowledge and every outcome deserves it alone.
Tawakkul is trust with reasons - knowing Who holds every affair makes reliance the sound response.
Your Lord is not unaware of what you do - effort nobody saw today was never actually unseen.

morning.en: Today's unseen belongs to Him and every matter returns to Him - so the verse says: worship, and rely.

night.en: Tomorrow's unseen is already His - and the One you leaned on today is not unaware of any of it.

gems.en: No living thing is left off His provision - you were never in danger of being the exception.
Where each creature dwells and where it comes to rest - all recorded in a clear register.
From the smallest insect upward, His care excludes nothing that moves upon the earth.

morning.en: Provision for every creature on earth is upon Allah - today's sustenance is already His to carry.

night.en: Every creature fed today was fed from Him - and tomorrow's provision sits in the same clear register.

gems.en: Salih came as 'their brother' - Allah guides through those who know your language and struggles.
Beneath every prophet's message runs one call: worship Allah alone - nothing else merits submission.
Raised from this earth and settled in it as its custodian - the ground you walk is a trust.
Qarib and Mujib - near, and answering. A sincere return never has to shout to be heard.

morning.en: Salih's assurance to his people opens your day as well: my Lord is near and responsive.

night.en: Salih's words hold at the day's end: ask His forgiveness, turn to Him - your Lord is near and answers.

gems.en: Sarah's amazement met gentle correction - what humans call miracle is routine to His power.
'Mercy and blessings upon you, people of the house' - Allah's chosen households carry His blessing.
Hamid and Majid - His worthiness of praise is intrinsic, resting on what He is, not our approval.

morning.en: What looks impossible to you sits lightly with Him - the angels called His decree no cause for wonder.

night.en: The angels' greeting still stands written: the mercy of Allah and His blessings upon the people of the house.

gems.en: Even after stern warning, the way home stays marked: ask pardon of your Lord, then turn to Him.
Istighfar then tawba - first the asking of pardon, then the changed conduct that completes it.
Rahim and Wadud - your return is met not with tolerance but with mercy and affection.
Prophets end warnings in hope - justice was named, but the last word given was mercy.

morning.en: Shu'ayb's invitation opens the day: ask forgiveness, then turn to Him - my Lord is Merciful, Affectionate.

night.en: Whatever today needs forgiven, the address stays open tonight: a Lord Merciful and Affectionate.

gems.en: Yusuf called his kingdom something given - position and power are held in trust, never owned.
His reading of dreams was taught, not talent - the gift that raised him came from Allah first.
'You are my protector in this world and the Hereafter' - guardianship that outlasts everything.
After all his success, Yusuf's ask was the ending - to finish in submission, with the righteous.

morning.en: Yusuf named his rank and knowledge as gifts received - what you hold today was likewise given.

night.en: Yusuf's prayer suits the day's end: You are my protector in this world and in the Hereafter.

gems.en: Even cleared of blame, Yusuf claimed no innocence - honesty about the self is prophetic practice.
The nafs keeps urging wrong - the struggle you feel is not failure; it is the standing condition.
Every resisted sin was His mercy at work - restraint is grace received, not strength self-made.
The verse ends where weakness needs it to: my Lord is Forgiving, Merciful - always within reach.

morning.en: Yusuf, though vindicated, would not acquit his own soul - watchfulness over the nafs is today's work too.

night.en: The soul urged today; sometimes you resisted. Both truths end in one place: my Lord is Forgiving, Merciful.

gems.en: Grief spoken to Him is not weakness - Yaqub aimed his pain at the only One who can answer it.
Yaqub held certainty others lacked - what he knew from Allah outweighed what they knew of loss.
The verse names anguish beside grief - the Qur'an distinguishes sorrow's depths and shames neither.
Grief and hope shared one prophetic heart - sorrow did not cancel his certainty in Allah.

morning.en: Yaqub set the direction for sorrow: complaint carried to Allah travels upward, not around.

night.en: Whatever ached today can travel Yaqub's route tonight: suffering and grief complained only to Allah.

gems.en: Yusuf pardoned without reproach - the same nobility the Prophet later showed the people of Makkah.
Yusuf forgave, then pointed to Allah - human pardon settles accounts; His forgiveness purifies.
Arham al-Rahimin, most merciful of the merciful - even Yusuf's pardon runs small beside His.

morning.en: Yusuf faced the brothers who wronged him and chose: no blame today. Forgiveness that complete exists.

night.en: Yusuf's 'no blame upon you today' drew on a deeper well - He is the most merciful of the merciful.

gems.en: The heavens and the earth are not neutral ground - everything in them is in a state of submission.
Matter submits by nature; you get to submit by choice - that choice is the worth of your worship.
Even shadows bend through morning and afternoon - worship runs finer than the eye assumes.
A verse of prostration: when it is recited, believers physically join creation's submission.

morning.en: Everything in the heavens and earth is already prostrating - your worship today joins what never stopped.

night.en: The shadows finished their evening prostration. Whatever worship you offered today joined all of creation's.

gems.en: The angels' word at the gate is peace - safety so complete it is the very first thing said.
The greeting names its reason: what you patiently endured. Endurance is what the welcome honors.
'Excellent is the final home' - the last address outweighs every cost paid on the way to it.

morning.en: 'Peace be upon you for what you patiently endured' - the greeting at the end is written for days like today.

night.en: The final home's greeting names endurance. If you carried something patiently today, it was seen.

gems.en: Anxiety has an address for its cure - hearts find tranquility in the remembrance of Allah.
Dhikr is wider than a phrase - recitation, prayer, reflection, plain awareness of Him all count.
'Unquestionably' - the verse states it as guarantee, not suggestion: dhikr settles the heart.

morning.en: The cure for a restless heart is named before the day begins: in the remembrance of Allah hearts find rest.

night.en: If the heart is still unsettled tonight, the verse holds its guarantee: His remembrance is where it rests.

gems.en: The ground under your feet was prepared for you - mountains to steady it, rivers to keep it alive.
Even fruit comes in pairs - balance is woven into creation, down to what sits on your table.
Night is drawn over day like a cover - the rhythm of work and rest was set into the world itself.
The signs are there for a people who reflect - today they open to the one who pauses to think.

morning.en: The earth you wake on was spread, anchored, and watered on purpose - a day lived here is a day among signs.

night.en: Night has been drawn over the day, just as the verse said. The day ends inside one of His signs.

gems.en: He erases what He wills and confirms what He wills - no decree sits beyond His authority.
Beneath every change is the Mother of the Book with Him - the unchanging source behind what shifts.
His decree is not rigid - it adapts by wisdom while the core stays constant in the preserved record.

morning.en: What is written can be erased or confirmed by Him - today's page is not as fixed as it feels.

night.en: Nothing decided today is beyond His power to erase or confirm - and the master record rests with Him.

gems.en: Plots side by side, same soil and water, different yields - more than material causes is at work.
One water feeds grapevine, grain, and palm - one source, and He brings out difference from it.
Some fruit excels over other fruit by His making - excellence is distributed by His will.
Signs for a people who reason - the differences in any garden reward the mind that asks why.

morning.en: Neighboring plots share one water yet differ in fruit - sameness of ground does not decide what grows today.

night.en: One water ran through every different thing that grew today. The source was single; the gifts were many.

gems.en: His knowledge reaches where no one else's can - even the hidden beginnings of life are seen.
What a womb loses or carries longer never left His knowledge - no such loss is unseen or unmeasured.
Everything with Him is by measure - nothing in your life is random, however unfinished it looks.

morning.en: What every mother carries is known to Him - and everything with Him, today included, is by due measure.

night.en: Whatever today held, it held nothing He did not know and nothing He did not measure.

gems.en: The Qur'an's stated purpose is transformation - from darkness to light, with His permission.
The journey out of darkness runs on His permission - and on a heart willing to be guided.
The path leads to the Exalted in Might, the Praiseworthy - perfect power, deserving all praise.

morning.en: The Book in your hands was sent for one movement: out of darkness, into light, by your Lord's permission.

night.en: However dark parts of today felt, the Book's whole direction of travel is out of darkness into light.

gems.en: For the messengers, reliance on the One who guided them was simply the logical response.
Past guidance is the messengers' proof for present trust - He who led you this far can be leaned on.
Their reliance included a vow of patience under harm - tawakkul stands firm through opposition.
'Upon Allah let the reliant rely' - repeated for emphasis, because trust needs constant renewing.

morning.en: The messengers saw no reason not to rely on Allah - He had guided them, and that was proof enough for trust.

night.en: The messengers' reasoning holds tonight: the One who guided you today can be trusted with tomorrow.

gems.en: Salah and spending stand side by side - devotion to Him and duty to people form one worship.
Secret giving guards dignity; open giving inspires others - both forms carry divine purpose.
A Day is coming with no trade and no ransom - what is given now is given while giving still counts.

morning.en: Prayer and giving belong to today - the verse points to a Day when no trade or friendship can be offered.

night.en: What you prayed and gave today went ahead of you - to a Day with no trade and no friendships to lean on.

gems.en: Ibrahim prayed for security and for protection from shirk - spiritual safety above physical comfort.
Even a prophet asked to be kept from idols - no one stands too high to ask for protection.
One dua marked Makkah as a place of safety for all generations - prayer can outlast its speaker.

morning.en: Ibrahim asked for a safe city and for his children's faith - a father's prayer put the soul first.

night.en: A father once prayed his children away from idols. The same protection can be asked for the people you love.

gems.en: Ismail and Ishaq arrived in Ibrahim's old age - some gifts come exactly when they look impossible.
'My Lord is the Hearer of supplication' - Ibrahim said it as testimony, after the answer came.
Through Ismail came Muhammad, through Ishaq came prophets - two sons, two rivers of prophethood.

morning.en: Ibrahim received sons when age said it was too late - the Hearer of supplication is not bound by likelihood.

night.en: Ibrahim praised the Hearer of supplication after the long wait. A late answer is still an answer.

gems.en: An establisher of prayer holds it up as a cornerstone - prayer as structure, not just habit.
Ibrahim asked prayer for his descendants too - a parent's highest wish is the children's faith.
The dua ends with 'accept my supplication' - the asking is ours, the acceptance is His alone.

morning.en: Ibrahim did not ask merely to pray - he asked to be made an establisher of prayer. That is today's aim.

night.en: The prayers of your day close the way Ibrahim closed his: Our Lord, accept my supplication.

gems.en: Ibrahim asked forgiveness for his parents - honoring them while holding fast to pure monotheism.
His prayer stretched to all believers - a heart formed by prophethood asks for everyone.
The prayer aims at the Day the account stands - forgiveness matters most where deeds are weighed.

morning.en: Ibrahim's circle of forgiveness took in his parents and every believer - yours can open that wide today.

night.en: Ibrahim's prayer fits tonight as it is: forgive me, my parents, and the believers, on the Day of account.

gems.en: Thankfulness multiplies what you already have - increase is a divine law, publicly promised.
Kufr here is ingratitude, not only disbelief - thanklessness is taken that seriously.
This law was proclaimed, not whispered - an open divine announcement meant for everyone to hear.

morning.en: A proclamation stands over today: gratitude is answered with increase - 'I will surely increase you.'

night.en: Whatever you thanked Him for today falls under the proclamation: gratitude is met with increase.

gems.en: The earth was made habitable on purpose - room to live, travel, and build was prepared for you.
Mountains steady the crust beneath your day - stability itself is a placed and deliberate gift.
'Every well-balanced thing' - populations, nutrients, seasons hold a calibration He maintains.
From tiny seeds He grows forests, crops, and medicine - what sustains life starts small with Him.

morning.en: The earth is spread, pinned by mountains, grown in measure - your day opens on a world kept in balance.

night.en: Everything that grew today grew in measure. The balance that held the world will hold it while you sleep.

gems.en: Wind is not random weather - it is sent, carrying pollen, seed, and moisture on assignment.
The water cycle over your head is maintained power - rain descends because He keeps sending it.
'You are not its retainers' - no one stores the sky's water at will; we only use what He gives.
'We gave you drink' - every glass of water today was a gift handed down, not a human achievement.

morning.en: Winds are sent bearing rain, and your drink is poured from the sky - today runs on what He sends.

night.en: Every drink of water today was given, not made. The verse leaves you supplied by Him, not self-sufficient.

gems.en: He introduces Himself as al-Ghafur - willing to cover sins and receive the one who repents.
Forgiveness is paired with ar-Rahim - His mercy pardons and then keeps giving beyond the pardon.
'Inform My servants' - hope was made part of the prophetic mission, not left as an afterthought.

morning.en: He had Himself announced to you as the Forgiving, the Merciful - that introduction stands over today.

night.en: Before sleep, the announcement stands as sent: it is I who am the Forgiving, the Merciful.

gems.en: 'It is We who sent down the Reminder' - the source speaks in majesty, and the source is Him.
Its Author is its guardian - preserved from distortion by promise, unique among scriptures.
Other miracles ended with their moment - the Qur'an's preservation is a miracle still running.
It is called the Reminder - theology, law, ethics, history, guidance, all in one protected place.

morning.en: The Book you open today is under guard - the One who sent it down took its protection on Himself.

night.en: Tonight the Reminder rests under the same guard as always - His promise does not sleep.

gems.en: There is no graduation from worship - it frames life from first breath to last.
Death is named 'the certainty' - the moment every doubt and ambiguity finally falls away.
The command is continuous - not occasional ritual but a sustained state of awareness of Him.
After all its stories and warnings, the surah closes on one directive: keep worshipping your Lord.

morning.en: 'Worship your Lord until certainty comes to you' - there is no retirement from faith, only continuation.

night.en: The day's worship ends but the command does not - service to Him simply continues into tomorrow.

gems.en: Wisdom reads the person in front of you - right message, right method, right moment for this heart.
Truth delivered beautifully gets past defenses - compassion is part of the message, not decoration.
Met with challenge, the standard stays - the best argument, offered with respect intact.
Guidance is His work, not yours - your part ends at the invitation, and that lifts the weight.

morning.en: Truth travels on manner - wisdom, beauty, and grace are how the way of your Lord is offered to anyone.

night.en: Every word of truth you offered today was the whole of your job - who it guides rests with your Lord.

gems.en: Sabr is not willpower squeezed from yourself - it is strength drawn from Him, renewed by connection.
The Prophet was told not to carry grief for those who refuse - his duty was to convey, not compel.
Schemes against truth are already seen by Allah - anxiety over plots is weight you can set down.
What was said to the Prophet reaches every believer facing opposition - the same relief is yours.

morning.en: The patience today asks of you is not self-made - sabr is drawn from Allah, and His supply meets the day.

night.en: The patience that carried you today was through Allah - the verse says it was never yours alone.

gems.en: He is not merely aware of the righteous - He is with them, present in support and protection.
Taqwa is not terror - conscious awareness of Him, a shield built from reverence and love.
Ihsan goes past obligation - sincerity and excellence beautifying whatever your hands touch.
Surah an-Nahl ends on this promise - after every blessing and trial, His companionship is the close.

morning.en: The verse names who Allah is with - those conscious of Him and those who do good. Today can place you there.

night.en: Where today held taqwa and good deeds, it held His company - the surah's closing promise ends the day.

gems.en: From breath to consciousness, His blessings outrun any count you could attempt.
Even our thin gratitude is met with Ghafur and Rahim - He keeps giving despite the shortfall.
The eye drifts to what is missing - the verse turns it back to gifts too many to enumerate.

morning.en: Counting His favors is a task no one completes - today opens with more than you can number.

night.en: The favors of today alone were past counting - and the Forgiving overlooked the thanks that fell short.

gems.en: Messengers were men, not angels - guidance came through lives relatable enough to follow.
'Ask the people of the reminder' - deep knowledge of scripture is meant to be sought out.
The messengers conveyed what was revealed to them - the teaching was received, not invented.

morning.en: Not knowing is no dead end - 'ask the people of the reminder' is the verse's open door for today.

night.en: Questions left open tonight have a direction to travel - toward the people of the reminder.

gems.en: From the smallest convenience to the greatest joy, nothing you hold came from your own power.
In hard moments people cry out to Him by instinct - dependence on Him is built into us.
The verse sets blessing beside adversity - He is easily forgotten in comfort, remembered in need.

morning.en: Every favor in your hands this morning has one origin - 'whatever you have of favor, it is from Allah.'

night.en: The favors of today came from Him, and every cry for help went to Him - both halves of the verse were lived.

gems.en: The Qur'an came to settle disputes - where voices conflict, it separates truth from falsehood.
The Book does two things at once - guidance that shows the path, mercy that heals along it.
Its full benefit opens to those who believe - faith unlocks its transformative power.

morning.en: Where people disagree, the Book was sent to make things clear - clarity is part of today's inheritance.

night.en: Disputes may continue around you; for the believer, the Book remains guidance and mercy at day's end.

gems.en: A spouse made from your own kind - companionship was designed into you, not stumbled upon.
Children and grandchildren extend His blessing forward - family is favor moving across generations.
Whatever wholesome thing sustains you today arrived from His generosity, pure by His choosing.
The verse marvels at favor denied - seeing your blessings as His keeps that denial far from you.

morning.en: Spouse, children, provision - the verse counts the blessings woven into your ordinary day as His giving.

night.en: The people under your roof and the food on your table were today's evidence - His favor, close at hand.

gems.en: Every skill you carry began at zero - what you know now measures what He has given since.
Hearing, sight, and heart are issued equipment - faculties made for perceiving what is true.
Using your hearing, sight, and heart the way the Giver guided is what gratitude looks like today.

morning.en: You entered the world knowing nothing - everything you understand today was handed to you piece by piece.

night.en: The hearing, sight, and heart you used all day were His gifts first - thanks is their natural return.

gems.en: A bird in flight is a sign in plain view - creation sustained visibly, above your ordinary errands.
None holds them up except Allah - each moment aloft is His continuous support, not law left running.
Faith is the eye that catches these signs - belief turns an everyday sky into evidence.

morning.en: Every bird overhead today is held by nothing except Allah - the sky carries His signature all day.

night.en: The birds rest tonight held by the same One who held them aloft - His support does not set with the sun.

gems.en: Justice gives each person their due - excellence gives more than was owed. Today has room for both.
Giving starts with those closest - your relatives hold a named place in today's generosity.
Private sin, public wrong, and oppression - the verse closes all three doors, hidden and seen.
The reminder repeats because forgetting repeats - His guidance arrives as often as you need it.

morning.en: One verse sets today's standard: justice as the floor, excellence above it, and your own kin first in line.

night.en: Justice, excellence, care for kin - wherever today touched them, it stood inside this verse's command.

gems.en: A confirmed oath is not paperwork - it is a trust with Allah Himself standing surety over it.
The One you invoked as witness is not passive - He knows the intention behind every commitment.
Kept or broken, your word sits in His full view - He knows what you do with every promise.

morning.en: Every promise you make today gains a witness at once - you place Allah as guarantor over your word.

night.en: The promises still standing tonight are still witnessed - Allah knows what you do with each one.

gems.en: Wealth, status, comfort - today's abundance carries an end date written into it.
What is with Allah does not deplete - His rewards never expire, His treasures never thin.
Patience is graded generously - reward measured by your best deeds, not your worst moments.

morning.en: Everything in your hands today is running out - what sits with Allah is the only stock that lasts.

night.en: Whatever today spent is gone; whatever was placed with Allah is keeping - His side never runs out.

gems.en: Male or female, the verse makes no distinction - righteous deeds weigh the same with Him.
A good life is not deferred payment - faith lived out starts transforming your days immediately.
The blessing is doubled - a wholesome life here, and reward measured by your best in the hereafter.

morning.en: Righteous work joined to faith carries a promise for today - a good life beginning now, not only later.

night.en: The good you joined to faith today is already working - a pure life now, best-deed reward ahead.

gems.en: Night for rest, day for seeking - the alternation you live inside is designed, sign upon sign.
The moon carries no light of its own - the dark of night was set deliberately, part of the design.
Work that sustains you for His sake is worship - daylight was granted for exactly that seeking.
Years, months, prayer times - the cycle you tell time by is His gift of measure.

morning.en: Daylight was made visible on purpose - today's light is an invitation to seek bounty from your Lord.

night.en: The sign of night has arrived on schedule - its darkness was made for rest as deliberately as the day.

gems.en: Worship of Him and honoring parents share one decree - the two duties were issued together.
When parents grow dependent, the duty grows with them - their old age raises your obligation.
Even 'uff' is off-limits - a sigh of annoyance marks the floor, and the floor sits that high.
A noble word is the standard - speech to parents is meant to honor, not merely avoid harm.

morning.en: One decree pairs two duties - worship Him alone, and goodness to your parents standing right beside it.

night.en: A generous word to a parent today kept the decree - down to the smallest sigh withheld.

gems.en: The lowered wing is a sheltering bird's - adulthood does not outgrow tenderness toward parents.
'My Lord, have mercy on them' - the dua for parents was composed by Allah and placed on your tongue.
They carried your helplessness once - their frailty now asks the same patience back.
The duty outlasts their lifetime - prayer and charity on their behalf keep the bond in force.

morning.en: The lowered wing of humility is today's posture - tenderness toward your parents as mercy in motion.

night.en: The dua He taught fits tonight - My Lord, have mercy on them both as they raised me when I was small.

gems.en: Outward duty can be seen by anyone - the love or reluctance beneath it is read by your Lord alone.
Past failures with parents are not final - genuine return finds Him ever-Forgiving.
Awwabin keep coming back after slipping - a lifetime of returning, and He receives every return.
Sincerity shows across a whole life - righteous character is what carries the repentance.

morning.en: Your Lord reads what is within you - the intention beneath today's duties is fully seen.

night.en: Whatever fell short today, the verse answered ahead - to those who keep returning, He is Forgiving.

gems.en: An empty hand does not excuse a hard face - dignity is owed even in refusal.
A gentle word spares the asker humiliation - softness stands in where money is missing.
Today's inability is not permanent - provision moves by His mercy, and tomorrow can open.
Charity is wider than money - respect, empathy, and prayer are giving your hand can always afford.

morning.en: Even a day with nothing to give still leaves something to offer - a gentle word is within reach.

night.en: The gentle words you managed today counted as giving - charity never depended on your wallet.

gems.en: Neither chained to your neck nor opened to the last coin - the hand is meant to move with measure.
Both extremes charge twice - blame from people and depletion within. Balance spares you both.
Moderation is the path itself - generous enough to lift others, prudent enough to stand tomorrow.
Giving that lasts beats giving that empties - sustained capacity to help is the wiser generosity.

morning.en: Two extremes are named and closed - a hand chained shut and a hand emptied out. Today walks between them.

night.en: If your hand moved with measure today, it ends the day neither chained nor bare - the balance held.

gems.en: Full measure and true weight are commanded - honest dealing is religion, not just good business.
Honesty is promised the best outcome - integrity outperforms the shortcut in both worlds.
Markets stay just one honest deal at a time - your fair transaction holds up a corner of the whole.

morning.en: Fair measure is worship in work clothes - every honest transaction today keeps a command of Allah.

night.en: Every fair measure you gave today lands where the verse said - the best way, and the best result.

gems.en: Speculation, hearsay, assumption - the verse closes the road to chasing what you do not know.
Hearing, sight, and heart are not passive receivers - each will answer for how it was used.
Testimony requires direct knowledge - careless words about others carry weight He will question.

morning.en: Today's rule of speech is knowledge - what you cannot verify is not yours to pass along.

night.en: What you declined to repeat today was this verse at work - hearing, sight, and heart kept answerable.

gems.en: Pride leaks into posture - humility is carried in the body, not only held in the heart.
You will not split the earth or match the mountains - creation's scale keeps you honestly sized.
Arrogance fails arithmetic - beside your actual power, pride has nothing to stand on.

morning.en: Humility has a gait - the verse reads arrogance in a walk before it ever reaches words.

night.en: The earth you walked today outlasts every proud stride - the gentle walk was the truthful one.

gems.en: Every atom, star, and creature is in worship - creation never pauses its tasbih around you.
The praise is real though unheard - your ears were not built to catch every mode of worship.
A universe glorifies Him, yet human failure meets patience - He remains Forbearing, Forgiving.

morning.en: Everything around you today is glorifying Him - a praise running constantly, just beyond your hearing.

night.en: The praise you could not hear today continues into the night - creation's tasbih does not sleep.

gems.en: Intellect, speech, upright bearing - your dignity is built in, granted to every child of Adam.
Carried over land and sea - mastery of travel is a trust to steward, not a trophy to hold.
The pure things that fed you today were His provision - goodness meant for grateful enjoyment.
Preferred over much of creation - the rank was His choosing, which makes it gratitude's business.

morning.en: You woke up honored - dignity was conferred on the children of Adam before anything was earned.

night.en: The honor conferred on Adam's children did not lapse at sunset - you end the day still carried by Him.

gems.en: Night prayer is worship beyond the required - a voluntary reach that lifts the one who makes it.
The praised station is the Prophet's - intercession for humanity, the reward of his devotion.
Guaranteed paradise, he still prayed until his feet swelled - devotion was never about the minimum.

morning.en: Part of the night stands open as an offer - tahajjud is extra worship with elevation attached.

night.en: The night ahead holds the offer the Prophet took up nightly - its quiet hours can still raise a rank.

gems.en: Entering and leaving with truth - integrity is asked at every transition, not only the big ones.
Supporting authority from Him - legitimacy no institution grants and none can take away.
Taught before the Hijrah - this is the prayer for standing at the edge of a major change.

morning.en: Every doorway today can be entered with truth - the dua asks that comings and goings stay sincere.

night.en: Today's entrances and exits are behind you - the dua that readied the Hijrah fits every threshold.

gems.en: What you do today takes the shape of what you are - deeds carry the print of your inner nature.
He alone knows who is best guided - the intentions and hidden struggles others miss, He sees.
Guidance arrives by different roads and paces - hardship for some, ease for others, each by nature.

morning.en: Today you will work in your own manner, as everyone does - and your Lord knows best whose way is guided.

night.en: The day showed everyone working in their own way - judging whose way was best guided rests with your Lord.

gems.en: Asked about the soul, the Prophet was told to say 'of my Lord's affair' - some realities exceed us.
All human knowledge amounts to 'only a little' - your limits today are by design, not failure.
Scholars asked to test him; he said only what was given - honesty about limits is prophetic.

morning.en: The soul that carries you through today is of your Lord's affair - some depths are His alone.

night.en: The day ends with questions still open - knowledge was given 'only a little,' and that is by His design.

gems.en: Not one guidance among many - the Qur'an points to the most upright way there is.
Faith joined to righteous action carries a stated promise - a great reward, announced in advance.
Belief, law, ethics, society - its guidance covers the whole of a human life, including yours.

morning.en: The Qur'an guides to what stands most upright - the straightest path through today is already in your hands.

night.en: The most upright path did not move tonight - the Qur'an's guidance holds steady for tomorrow.

gems.en: An ocean of ink runs out; His words do not - divine knowledge has no far shore.
'His words' are wider than speech - decrees, wisdom, and signs written through all of creation.
Add a second sea of ink and it still runs dry - His knowledge stands beyond all multiplication.
After the Cave, Khidr, and Dhul-Qarnayn, the surah admits its stories are drops from His ocean.

morning.en: If the sea were ink for your Lord's words, the sea would run dry first - today unfolds inside that vastness.

night.en: Everything learned in a lifetime, let alone today, stays a drop - His words outlast every sea of ink.

gems.en: The companions worth keeping are named: those who call on their Lord, seeking His face alone.
The glitter of this life can pull the eyes off sincere people - the verse holds the gaze steady.
A heart heedless of His remembrance makes a poor guide - its affairs run to excess and waste.

morning.en: Company shapes the day - the verse keeps you beside those who call on their Lord morning and evening.

night.en: Morning and evening were both named - those still calling on their Lord at this hour are the company to keep.

gems.en: Possessions and children are adornment - beautiful on life's surface, not its substance.
Enduring good deeds outlast their moment - they stay with the soul when all else stays behind.
Good deeds are 'better for hope' - they give the future a footing possessions cannot give.
'Better with your Lord for reward' - His measure of what you gained today is not the market's.

morning.en: Wealth and children adorn this life - what endures with your Lord out of today is the good you do.

night.en: Whatever today added or subtracted, the enduring good deeds kept their rank: better with your Lord.

gems.en: Zechariah named his weakened bones without pretense - prayer can begin from exactly how you are.
He described age as fire spreading through his hair - honest about time, and still asking.
'Never have I been unhappy in my prayer to You' - years of asking build a history to lean on.
Twice in one verse he says 'my Lord' - reverence and closeness living in one repeated word.

morning.en: Zechariah brought weak bones and white hair to his Lord and still asked - today needs no strength to pray.

night.en: Zechariah's record can close this day: a lifetime of calling on his Lord, never once left unhappy.

gems.en: Wudd is more than acceptance - a special affection the Most Merciful Himself sets in hearts.
The verse pairs believing with doing - faith that moves the hands is the faith the promise names.
Part of the reward is social - He places love for the righteous in the hearts around them.

morning.en: A promise opens the day: for those who believe and do right, the Most Merciful Himself appoints love.

night.en: If faith and good deeds filled today, the promise holds tonight: the Most Merciful appoints affection.

gems.en: The verse says 'You alone' before 'we worship' - He comes first even in the grammar of your day.
Guidance, strength, provision - every kind of help you will need today has one source.
Halfway through the Fatiha, talk about God becomes talk to Him. Prayer is that close.

morning.en: The day ahead rests on two anchors: worship that is His alone, and help that is His to give.

night.en: The day is done. Every bit of help that carried you through it came from the One you worship.

gems.en: Even the Prophet asked for guidance daily. Needing to ask puts you in the best company.
The straight path is simply the direct one - no drama, no extremes, just the clear way to Him.
'Guide us' never stops being asked. Guidance comes as a daily supply, not a one-time gift.

morning.en: You do not need the whole route today - only enough guidance for today's stretch of the path.

night.en: Guidance did not expire at sunset. The One who led you through today will lead through tomorrow.

gems.en: Above every authority of the day stands al-Malik al-Haqq - the one Sovereign whose rule is true.
Even the Prophet was told not to rush revelation - knowledge is received properly, at its pace.
Of everything, knowledge is what he was commanded to ask more of - 'Rabbi zidni ilma.'

morning.en: One prayer is worth carrying into everything today: 'My Lord, increase me in knowledge.'

night.en: Whatever today taught, the asking does not close: 'My Lord, increase me in knowledge' has no last day.

gems.en: Patience over what they say is the prophetic answer - steadfastness where anger would be easy.
Sunrise, sunset, night hours, the day's edges - praise is spaced so remembrance never lapses.
'That you may be satisfied' - steady praise arrives at a contentment that He Himself gives.

morning.en: Praise is set before the sun even rises - the day's hard words are met with tasbih, not anger.

night.en: The verse names this hour too - praise in the night's periods, moving toward 'that you may be satisfied.'

gems.en: Spiritual responsibility begins at your own door - family is the first congregation.
Steadfastness is asked of you alongside the call - example carries further than instruction.
'We ask you not for provision; We provide for you' - prayer never costs you your sustenance.
The closing promise is plain: the outcome belongs to those who keep God-consciousness.

morning.en: 'Enjoin prayer upon your family' - the day's spiritual leadership starts inside your own walls.

night.en: A house that prayed today ran on His provision, not its own - and the outcome still belongs to taqwa.

gems.en: What Musa heard first is the foundation: no deity except Him, so worship belongs to Him alone.
Prayer's stated purpose is remembrance - salah exists to keep Him at the center of attention.
Five set times anchor a wider aim - awareness of Him running through the hours between them.
'So worship Me' is His own direct command - for one who knows the truth, worship is its due.

morning.en: The words Musa heard at the fire still order a day: worship Him, and pray to remember Him.

night.en: If prayer punctuated today, it did its stated work: remembrance of Him, kept alive until this hour.

gems.en: Revelation came as relief, not burden - what He asks of you carries mercy inside it.
The Prophet carried his people's guidance so heavily that heaven itself addressed the weight.
The Qur'an's purpose is stated plainly - not difficulty, but a reminder for whoever seeks truth.

morning.en: The Qur'an was not sent down to cause distress - what He gave you to live by today is mercy, not weight.

night.en: The Book you carry into tomorrow was not sent to distress - it was sent as reminder and relief.

gems.en: 'I am with you' meant awareness, protection, and support - a presence no distance interrupts.
'Fear not' came before the hardest mission - courage in faith is acting while fear is still real.
His hearing and seeing are active - every word of the oppressor, every act against the oppressed.

morning.en: Musa and Harun walked toward Pharaoh on one assurance: 'I am with you both; I hear and I see.'

night.en: The One who told Musa 'I hear and I see' missed nothing of today - not a word, not an act.

gems.en: 'No deity except Him' clears the field - no rival power stands over anything today holds.
Each of His beautiful names opens a different window on the same single perfection.
Husna means more than lovely - every name of His is the utmost that attribute can be.
'To Him belong' - the perfect names are His alone; no creation truly possesses them.

morning.en: One truth stands beneath the whole day: no deity except Him, and His are the most beautiful names.

night.en: The day closes under the same names it opened under - all of them beautiful, all of them His.

gems.en: Ghaffar is a permanent name, not a passing mood - His readiness to forgive does not expire.
The way back has a shape: turn, believe, do right, keep walking - transformation, not just words.
'Then continues in guidance' - repentance opens the road; staying on it is part of the return.

morning.en: The door for today is stated in His own voice: 'I am the Perpetual Forgiver' of whoever turns back.

night.en: If today needs forgiving, the name holds tonight: Ghaffar, the Perpetual Forgiver of whoever turns back.

gems.en: Rahma lil-alamin - his mercy reaches all humanity and creation, not one community alone.
One word holds his whole mission - 'only as a mercy' - every teaching of his serves it.
'We sent you' - the Prophet was commissioned by Allah Himself, chosen and sent with purpose.
'The worlds' is deliberately plural - humans, jinn, animals, the earth itself, all within it.

morning.en: It is the Mawlid - the day opens on his description: not sent except as a mercy to the worlds.

night.en: The Mawlid closes with the verse still true: he was sent as a mercy to the worlds - yours among them.

gems.en: Night, day, sun, and moon run a course He wrote - time itself moves under His control.
'Swimming' is the Qur'an's word for celestial motion - stated fourteen centuries ahead of astronomy.
The verse gives the sun and moon a Maker - lights to live by, never lights to worship.

morning.en: The sun you rise with is swimming in its orbit - the day arrives by His arrangement, not by chance.

night.en: The night now over you was created, same as the day - the moon above is swimming where He set it.

gems.en: The scales are qist, perfectly just - judgment holds not the slightest unfairness for any soul.
A deed the weight of a mustard seed is still brought forth - smallness never disqualifies good.
He is sufficient as Accountant - no assistant needed, no record incomplete, no verdict unfair.
'No soul will be treated unjustly at all' - no good unrewarded, no innocence punished.

morning.en: The scales set for the Day of Resurrection are exact - nothing done today will be lost or miscounted.

night.en: Nothing from today slipped the record - a mustard seed's weight of good is enough to be brought forth.

gems.en: He raised them from guided to guides - the ones worth following were shaped by Him first.
Goodness was made natural to them - He inspired the very doing of good in His chosen servants.
Prayer beside zakah in one breath - devotion to Him and duty to people are one worship.

morning.en: It is the birth of Imam Hasan - the verse gives the day its frame: leaders who guide by His command.

night.en: The birth of Imam Hasan closes the day on the verse's pattern: guides appointed by Him, worshippers of Him.

gems.en: Ayyub called his Lord from inside the pain - turning to Him in distress is faith, not weakness.
'Adversity has touched me' - suffering named gently, without complaint: patience kept graceful.
Even in agony Ayyub appealed to mercy, not explanation - 'You are Most Merciful of the merciful.'
Years of illness and loss never unseated his worship - Ayyub remains the measure of sabr.

morning.en: Ayyub's whole prayer fits in a breath: harm has touched me, and You are the Most Merciful of the merciful.

night.en: Whatever touched you today can be named as Ayyub named his - gently, to the Most Merciful of the merciful.

gems.en: The Qur'an names Yunus by his trial - even prophets carry one defining test through their story.
Yunus left in anger at rejection - frustration is human, felt even by prophets carrying truth.
For a moment he thought distance was possible - a lapse the Qur'an records without hiding it.
'In the darknesses' - night, sea, and the whale's belly - crisis layered three deep, and he prayed.

morning.en: From night, sea, and the whale's belly, Yunus still called - no darkness today is too deep to pray from.

night.en: The words from the darknesses fit this hour: no deity but You, glory to You, I was of the wrongdoers.

gems.en: The response came at once - no situation had drifted too far for His mercy to reach it.
The rescue was double - out of the whale, and out of the grief of his own mistake.
One prophet's rescue is written as a rule - 'thus do We save the believers.'
His words remain the formula of return: no deity but You, glory to You, I was of the wrongdoers.

morning.en: Yunus was answered and saved from the distress - and the verse widens it: thus do We save the believers.

night.en: If today held a distress you carried to Him in faith, it fell under the verse's rule: thus does He save.

gems.en: The wish for family and legacy is not selfish - Zechariah carried it straight into prayer.
Even while asking, he confessed 'You are the best of inheritors' - all returns to Him in the end.
Zechariah asked at an age when the answer seemed impossible - it is never too late to ask Him.
He wanted a child to carry the mission forward - the request aimed at His service, not comfort.

morning.en: 'My Lord, do not leave me alone' - Zechariah named his loneliness to the One who could end it.

night.en: Zechariah's dua can end the day: the need named honestly, and the inheritance of all things left to Him.

gems.en: Faith and works complete each other - belief gives deeds their weight, deeds give belief its proof.
Nothing sincere is wasted - every good deed done in faith is kept, rewarded, unforgotten.
'We are recorders' - He Himself keeps the record of your effort, exact and just.

morning.en: Effort made in faith today carries a guarantee - 'no denial will there be for his effort.'

night.en: If faith carried today's efforts, none of them can be denied - He recorded each one Himself.

gems.en: His guidance moves with intention - a sincere, receptive heart is exactly where it lands.
The verses are bayyinat - clear signs. What they were sent to show you is not hidden.
'We sent it down' - the Qur'an descends from the highest realm, aimed at guiding humanity.

morning.en: Whatever you read of the Qur'an today was sent down clear - and its guidance is intended, not accidental.

night.en: If anything in the Qur'an reached you today, that was not chance - He guides whom He intends.

gems.en: One man was told to proclaim, and the call outlived him - an invitation without border or era.
The hard road is part of the worship - distance walked for Him purifies intention, lifts reward.
'They will come' is stated as certainty - the call placed on Ibrahim's lips is still answered.

morning.en: It is Arbaeen. The verse's image is alive today: pilgrims on foot, arriving from every distant pass.

night.en: Arbaeen closes. Walkers filled the roads again today, and the verse's image was easy to believe.

gems.en: Yudafi'u is active - He does not merely allow your safety, He takes up your defense.
Two traits sit outside His love - betrayal and ingratitude, opposites of His own faithfulness.
Iman is more than conviction - the verse ties faith directly to being defended by Him.

morning.en: Today has a defense already arranged: Allah Himself defends those who believe.

night.en: If you kept faith through today, the verse says its shield stood: Allah defends those who believe.

gems.en: Understanding is the heart's work - eyes can be perfect while the sight within goes dark.
It is hearts within breasts that go blind - dimmed by arrogance, prejudice, and materialism.
The command to travel the earth is for reflection - journeys are meant to teach the heart.

morning.en: The verse's concern for today is not your eyesight but your heart - that is where seeing happens.

night.en: Whatever your eyes took in today, the verse points deeper: it is hearts, not eyes, that lose their sight.

gems.en: Ruku and sujud put submission into the body - worship performed with your whole frame.
'Worship your Lord' points all devotion one direction - nothing else receives what is His.
Prostration alone is not the whole command - worship is completed by good done for His creation.
Falah - real success - is promised where worship and good deeds arrive together.

morning.en: The day's formula is set before it starts: bow, prostrate, worship your Lord, do good - then success.

night.en: If today held both prayer and one good act, you walked the verse's own path toward falah.

gems.en: The striving due to Him is your utmost, offered sincerely - measured by His right, not by ease.
He has chosen you - selection carries honor and assignment in the same breath.
He placed no hardship in the religion - what He asks was designed to be carried.
This is the millah of your father Ibrahim - pure submission with the oldest roots.
'Muslims' was never a label you invented - He named you, in earlier scriptures and in this one.
The Messenger witnesses over you, and you over humanity - your conduct joins a chain of testimony.
Prayer reaches up and zakat reaches out - two pillars holding both directions of faith.
Holding fast to Allah is a grip meant for every circumstance, not only the difficult ones.
He is your Mawla - and the verse grades Him itself: excellent the protector, excellent the helper.

morning.en: The day opens on a chosen people and an unburdened path: strive for Him with the striving due to Him.

night.en: The day ends where the verse does: holding fast to Him - excellent the protector, excellent the helper.

gems.en: The wording was given to the Prophet - making it the taught, reliable way to ask for grace.
Forgiveness covers what you did; mercy adds what you lack - the prayer asks for both at once.
'Best of the merciful' - every other mercy you have ever received stands below His.
A surah describing believers ends in this plea - humility and hope are where its qualities arrive.

morning.en: The Prophet was taught the day's shortest prayer: 'My Lord, forgive and have mercy' - and it is yours to say.

night.en: The surah's last words fit the day's last hour: My Lord, forgive and have mercy, best of the merciful.

gems.en: Isa and his mother are one sign together - proof His creating is not bound by natural law.
In their most exposed season He provided height, security, and water - His care arrives concrete.
The refuge was elevated and watered - safety arranged so worship and rest could both happen.

morning.en: The verse opens the day with His care: a mother and her son, sheltered on high ground with flowing water.

night.en: The night closes on the verse's picture of Him: a Lord who shelters His servants when they are exposed.

gems.en: Privacy carries divine protection - a home's threshold is honored before it is crossed.
Salam is more than politeness - it invokes His mercy and names the bond between believers.
'That is best for you' - etiquette at the door is counted toward taqwa, not mere manners.
The closing invites reflection - His ordinances guard the person and the community at once.

morning.en: Today's courtesy is revealed, not invented: seek welcome, greet with peace, and then enter.

night.en: Every door entered with greeting and welcome today kept a revealed protocol - 'that is best for you.'

gems.en: Physical light and inner clarity share one origin - all illumination begins with Him.
Niche, glass, lamp - guidance arrives protected in layers, kept safe and made brighter.
Neither eastern nor western - His guidance belongs to no single geography, lit by its own purity.
Nur ala nur - guidance compounds: one truth received makes the next easier to see.

morning.en: Every light you move through today has one source - Allah, the Light of the heavens and the earth.

night.en: House lamps go dark tonight; the Light of the heavens and the earth does not - He guides to it whom He wills.

gems.en: Worship is not a human invention - it is the natural state of everything in the heavens and earth.
Each creature has known its own prayer - glorifying Him is woven into how things exist.
No praise goes unnoticed - from atoms to galaxies, He is Knowing of every act of worship.

morning.en: You wake into a worshipping world - birds on the wing already know their prayer and their praise.

night.en: Whatever remembrance you offered today joined creation's constant praise - and He knows all of it.

gems.en: All life shares one ingredient - water, named in the verse long before laboratories agreed.
On the belly, on two legs, on four - the variety of movement is deliberate design on display.
Creation is not a finished event - He creates what He wills, and His making continues.
The verse closes on capability without ceiling - He is over all things competent.

morning.en: Every creature you cross paths with today began the same way - from water, by His deliberate making.

night.en: Everything alive tonight traces to the same water and the same will - He is over all things competent.

gems.en: Night is called clothing - a covering the world is dressed in for shelter, mercy, and rest.
Subat - each sleep is a rehearsal of leaving, and each waking a rehearsal of being raised.
Daybreak shares its root with resurrection - every morning is His proof that the dead can rise.

morning.en: You have already lived the verse this morning - sleep a small death, waking a small resurrection.

night.en: The clothing of night is being drawn over you now - and tomorrow's rising is already in its name.

gems.en: Sweet and bitter share the same water and stay themselves - His ordering runs beneath the surface.
The barzakh is invisible yet effective - nearness without dissolving is His arrangement.
Commentators read the seas as truth and falsehood - near neighbors in this world, never one thing.

morning.en: Fresh and salt run side by side today without merging - He keeps boundaries even inside the sea.

night.en: The two seas keep their line through the dark - distinctions He has set do not blur overnight.

gems.en: The human story begins from water - dignity built by Him out of the humblest material.
He made kinship twice over - the line you are born into, and the bond marriage creates.
'Your Lord is ever competent' - family itself is presented as His craftsmanship.

morning.en: Every tie you have - by blood or by marriage - was woven by Him, and your Lord is ever able.

night.en: The relatives on your mind tonight, by blood or by marriage, are His weaving - and He remains able.

gems.en: Al-Hayy alladhi la yamut - the one refuge that cannot be outlived stands apart from all creation.
Glorifying joined with praise - awe at what He is, thanks for what He gives, in a single breath.
He is fully Acquainted with His servants' sins - nothing needs reporting, and nothing is missed.

morning.en: Everything you might lean on today can fail except One - the Ever-Living who does not die.

night.en: You can release the day into hands that never weaken - the Ever-Living who does not die keeps the night.

gems.en: Constellations, sun, and moon are placements - the sky overhead is His power and wisdom on display.
The verse opens with Tabaraka - every good that reaches you flows from the One it names.
The sun burns as siraj, the moon shines as munir - lit and reflecting, told apart in a word each.

morning.en: The sky you walk under today was furnished deliberately - constellations set, a lamp lit, a moon made bright.

night.en: The moon out tonight is munir - a light He arranged to reflect - and blessed is He who placed it.

gems.en: Ibad al-Rahman - the title is lived in conduct: His mercy visible in how you carry yourself.
Walking hawnan is neither swagger nor shrinking - dignity carried with modest ease.
Met with harshness, they spend one word - peace - and keep their dignity out of the exchange.
The provokers are named ignorant - stepping back from them is wisdom, not defeat.

morning.en: The servants of the Most Merciful are known by their walk - today can be moved through gently.

night.en: If any harshness met you today and peace was your answer, you walked as the Rahman's servants walk.

gems.en: Tawba joined to changed deeds is described as arriving - a return to Allah that is received.
Regret alone is half the turn - the verse asks the inside and the outside to change together.
Mataba - the wording is total: not a half-turn or a hedge, but a whole return to Allah.

morning.en: Turning back to Him is open this morning - and the verse pairs it with right action to make it whole.

night.en: If today held one honest turning and one right deed, the verse calls that a true return to Him.

gems.en: Ashya'ahum - their things - what belongs to people is theirs by right, and rights are guarded.
Shortchanging is never contained - one person cheated feeds corruption across the earth.
The verse counts the harm twice - once against the person, once against the society around them.

morning.en: Today's dealings carry a revealed instruction: no one leaves your hands with less than their due.

night.en: If your dealings today left no one short, both of the verse's commands were kept in your hands.

gems.en: The people saw capture; Musa saw his Lord - certainty can stand beside panic and hold.
'With me is my Lord' - not distant rescue but companionship, personal and present inside the crisis.
Musa had no plan yet, only trust - guidance arrives at the moment it is needed, not before.
His first word was No - the premise of despair can be refused before any answer exists.

morning.en: Whatever backs you into a corner today, Musa's answer stands ready: my Lord is with me; He will guide me.

night.en: Nothing had parted yet when Musa spoke his trust - the words still hold tonight: He will guide me.

gems.en: Means work by permission - Ibrahim traced every cure past medicine and hands to the Healer.
'When I am ill' - even a prophet says it plainly; vulnerability is human, not a failure of faith.
Fa-huwa - it is He - the wording closes every other door on the power to truly cure.

morning.en: Ibrahim's words travel well into any day: and when I am ill, it is He who cures me.

night.en: Whatever ails you as the day ends is known to the One Ibrahim named - it is He who cures me.

gems.en: Their knowledge was given - the verse settles its origin before recording a single achievement.
Their first act on receiving greatness was praise - blessing acknowledged upward, not claimed.
'Favored us over many' - gratitude that names the gift while still honoring other believers.
Father and son are named together - knowledge passed down as a trust is part of the design.

morning.en: Whatever ability today draws on was given - Dawud and Sulayman met theirs with Alhamdulillah.

night.en: Anything you did well today had the source their knowledge did - and their response fits: Alhamdulillah.

gems.en: The desperate one's call gets through - His answering has no barrier and no precondition.
He does not only hear hardship - He removes it; His protection is active involvement.
You are placed as an inheritor of the earth - answered, protected, and handed responsibility.

morning.en: If the day brings you to your limit, this verse waits there: He answers the desperate one who calls.

night.en: If any hour today felt desperate, the verse's claim stands over it: He answers, and He removes the harm.

gems.en: Reliance on Allah is what makes truth speakable - confidence in Him comes first, courage follows.
The message he carried is called clear truth - examined honestly, it shows itself.
This was said to steady the Prophet under rejection - truth does not shake when people turn away.

morning.en: The Prophet was told to rely on Allah because he stood on clear truth - trust and truth travel together.

night.en: Rejection never moved the Prophet from clear truth - what you stood on honestly today still stands tonight.

gems.en: Tawba begins where excuses end - Musa named his own wrong before asking for anything.
'He forgave him' comes without pause - the Forgiving, the Merciful is faster than guilt expects.
Musa said 'I wronged myself' - sin's first casualty is the sinner's own soul, and he knew it.

morning.en: Musa's whole repentance took one honest sentence - and forgiveness arrived within the same verse.

night.en: If tonight holds a wrong, Musa's sentence still works: name it, ask forgiveness - He is the Forgiving.

gems.en: The lifting of the oppressed is His declared will - authority rooted in guidance, not brute power.
The oppressed are made a'imma, leaders - in Shia understanding, leadership is designated by Allah.
Shia scholars read here the Mahdi's return - the oppressed will lead, and the earth is inherited.

morning.en: On the birth of Imam al-Mahdi, the verse's promise has a face: the oppressed made leaders and heirs.

night.en: The night of his birth holds the verse's assurance: Allah still intends the oppressed to inherit.

gems.en: Your best words can carry truth to a heart's door - only Allah takes it inside.
'But Allah guides whom He wills' - the final word over every heart is His, not any persuader's.
He is most knowing of the guided - who will accept is known to Him before they ever hear.
'Whom you like' holds the Prophet's love for his people - even love that deep cannot compel faith.

morning.en: Even the Prophet could not place faith inside a heart he loved - guiding hearts belongs to Allah alone.

night.en: If someone you love is far from faith tonight, this verse lifts the weight: guidance was never yours to force.

gems.en: Everything you have been given carries the same label: enjoyment of this life, and its adornment.
What sits with Allah outlasts everything in your hands - and outshines it too.
The appeal is to reason itself - trading the eternal for the temporary fails the intellect first.
Better and more lasting - His reward wins on quality and on duration, both named in one breath.

morning.en: Whatever today hands you is enjoyment and adornment - what is with Allah stays better, and longer.

night.en: Whatever adorned today is already fading - what is with Allah is still better, and still more lasting.

gems.en: This verse follows warning on purpose - however dark the description, the way back stays open.
Success asks for three together: a turning heart, a believing conviction, and hands that do right.
When Allah says 'it is hoped', mercy is speaking - for the one who returns, the outcome is success.

morning.en: The door out of any past stands open today: repent, believe, do right - and success is the promised end.

night.en: If any part of today was a turning back to Him, you end it among those this verse expects to succeed.

gems.en: Night and day both arrive from His mercy - the most overlooked blessing is the frame of life itself.
Rest and effort are both assigned - stillness by night, striving by day, one balanced design.
Today's work is not separate from faith - the verse itself calls earning a seeking of His bounty.
The cycle's stated goal is gratitude - day and night exist so that perhaps you will thank Him.

morning.en: The day opening in front of you is His mercy with a stated purpose: seek from His bounty in it.

night.en: Night was made for you to rest in - receiving it as His mercy is the gratitude the verse hoped for.

gems.en: 'We believe' is a claim until tried - testing is how genuine faith is told from the easy kind.
The standard sits above lip service - faith shows itself in holding steady when holding is hard.
Trials purify - they firm up conviction and show a belief its own truth.
The surah opens by confronting an assumption - belief without testing was never the arrangement.

morning.en: Faith claimed today will be tried - the verse challenges anyone who assumed it would go unexamined.

night.en: If today tried your faith, that was not abandonment - it was the stated way belief is proven real.

gems.en: Faith grows from looking, not only reasoning - the command is to go and see creation firsthand.
The power that began life is proof it can be made again - the final creation is already promised.
Over all things competent - no promise of His waits on a capability He might lack.
Studying origins is worship here - the verse itself sends you out to look at how things began.

morning.en: The world you move through today is evidence on display - observing how He creates is itself commanded.

night.en: Everything you saw today began by His hand - and the One who began it will produce the final creation.

gems.en: Recitation is more than sound - reading, grasping, and living the Book are one engagement.
Establishing prayer means keeping it standing - consistent, present-hearted, whole.
Prayer done properly pushes back at sin itself - it purifies the heart that would have slipped.
And the remembrance of Allah is greater - connection to Him outranks even the shield it provides.

morning.en: Prayer is sent into your day as a guard - it stands between you and what you might have done.

night.en: If prayer stood through your day, it was working as described - holding you back from what harms.

gems.en: The best manner joins firmness with kindness - conviction that respects the person across from it.
The one exception is injustice - aggression may be answered firmly; courtesy is not surrender.
'Our God and your God is one' - common ground is declared before difference is argued.
Submission to Him is the oldest identity - every prophet and righteous soul shared it.

morning.en: If conviction meets difference today, the verse sets the manner: nothing but the best way.

night.en: Where you spoke across difference today in the best manner, you kept this verse whole.

gems.en: 'O My servants' is a term of nearness - the summons opens with belonging before it commands.
When a place chokes your worship, the earth is wide - moving for His sake has always been an option.
The wording narrows to Him alone - whatever else shifts, worship stays the one non-negotiable.
