morning.en: He opens with 'O My servants' and offers His wide earth - where you stand is not worship's only home.

night.en: If today felt narrow, the verse stays wide: His earth is spacious, and worship travels with you.

gems.en: Death exempts no one - the one appointment every soul shares levels every rank before it.
Death is not an ending into nothing - it is a return, to Him, with all that we did.
'Taste' makes death personal - not a concept held at a distance but a moment each soul meets.

morning.en: Today is one day of a journey with a known destination - every soul returns to Him.

night.en: The day closes a little nearer home - the return the verse names is to Him, not to nothing.

gems.en: Your striving improves the only soul it can - yours. That is where all its benefit was aimed.
Nothing you do adds to Him or takes from Him - He is free of need of all the worlds.
The struggle meant here is inward - against the lower self, its pull, and its excuses.
Seen and unseen, every world needs Him - and He needs nothing in any of them.

morning.en: Every effort you make for Him today lands in your own account - Allah needs none of it.

night.en: Whatever you strove against today, the gain was yours alone - He asked for nothing He needed.

gems.en: Creatures that store nothing still eat - provision is His doing before it is yours.
Every unworried bird is a lesson in trust - living today without carrying tomorrow.
He is the Hearing, the Knowing - your need reached Him before you found words for it.

morning.en: Countless creatures woke today carrying no provision - He will feed them, and you.

night.en: Everything that ate today was fed by Him - your tomorrow rests with the same Provider.

gems.en: This life is called diversion and amusement - absorbing enough to distract from what is eternal.
The Hereafter is called al-hayawan - not a second life but the only one that deserves the word.
'If only they knew' - the truth is not hidden; it waits on attention people do not give it.

morning.en: Hold today lightly - this life is named diversion and play, and the next is named the real life.

night.en: Today's portion of diversion is spent - the life that deserves the name is still ahead.

gems.en: Effort spent seeking Him is never lost - guidance to His paths is guaranteed to the striving.
'Our ways' is plural - more than one valid road reaches Him, fitted to different lives.
'With' is more than watching - Allah accompanies the good-doer through the doing.
Ihsan is excellence with eyes lifted - worshipping as if you see Him, faith at its highest grade.

morning.en: Striving for Him carries a sworn outcome today: 'We will surely guide them to Our ways.'

night.en: If today held striving for His sake, guidance is already moving toward you - the promise is emphatic.

gems.en: Kindness to parents is Allah's own commission - care for them is obligation, not favor.
Obedience to parents ends where obedience to Allah would break - and even refusal stays respectful.
When loyalties collide, weigh them by the ending: the return is to Him, and deeds will be shown.
'That of which you have no knowledge' - faith stands on knowing; shirk cannot produce its evidence.

morning.en: Goodness to your parents is enjoined from above - today it stands just after worship itself.

night.en: If you gave your parents goodness today, you kept a command Allah tied to Himself.

gems.en: East and west are His, so no direction is away from Him. Sincerity finds Him from anywhere.
The Face of Allah is His attention and favor - whoever turns sincerely stands under His gaze.
He is Wasi, the Boundless - nothing you meet today sits outside His awareness or His mercy.
Sincerity matters more than precise direction. He sees the turn, not just the destination.

morning.en: Wherever you turn today, you are already facing Him.

night.en: The day is closing. Nothing you did in sincerity was out of His sight.

gems.en: Directions differ; the race does not. Good is the one finish line every community shares.
Faith here is a race, not a waiting room. Good is something you move toward, not admire.
However scattered today leaves you feeling, gathering is promised. No one is lost to Him.
The One who set the race can also gather every runner. Nothing about the end is beyond Him.

morning.en: Whatever direction others face today, the call you carry is one: race toward what is good.

night.en: The race pauses for the night. Wherever this day left you, you are still within reach of His gathering.

gems.en: That the Lord of all things returns your remembrance personally is an honor with no equal.
Gratitude here is a verb. A blessing is not fully received until it is acknowledged and answered.
Ingratitude is not neutral; blessings left unacknowledged quietly become blessings denied.
Remembrance is wider than words: a thought of Him, an act done for Him - all of it is dhikr.

morning.en: Today carries a promise straight from Him: remember Me, and I will remember you.

night.en: Each time He crossed your mind today, He was remembering you. That exchange never once failed.

gems.en: Patience and prayer work as a pair - one steadies you inside, the other connects you upward.
Sabr is not gritting your teeth in a corner. It is faith kept upright while difficulty passes.
Prayer in hardship is not a last resort - it is the refuge that was prescribed first.
'With the patient' is presence, not observation. In your endurance, you have company.

morning.en: Whatever today demands, you come with two helps that do not run out: patience and prayer.

night.en: If you endured anything today, you did not endure it alone - He was with you inside the patience.

gems.en: Tests were promised, not threatened. A hard day is the path working, not the path failing.
The five tests cover everything a person can lose - and the verse saw each one coming.
The verse lists hardships and ends in good news. Patience turns each loss into tidings.
The test is 'something of' loss - a portion, never the whole. Measure is built into the trial.

morning.en: Trials today are not signs of His absence - the verse promised them, and promised the patient good news.

night.en: If today took something from you, the verse's ending is yours tonight: good tidings for the patient.

gems.en: From the night-day cycle to the clouds held overhead, the ordinary world is a list of signs.
Ships carry, rain feeds, winds are steered - the world was arranged with your benefit in mind.
These signs address people who think. Reflection is not a detour from faith; it is the road in.
Every rain that greens dead ground is a small rehearsal of resurrection you can watch.

morning.en: The sky, the rain, the wind crossing your street today - all of it speaks to anyone who will think.

night.en: The night arriving now is itself one of the signs. The day alternated exactly as He said it would.

gems.en: Provision is wider than the plate: everything pure that sustains you today comes from Him.
A meal becomes worship the moment you notice the Provider behind it.
'If it is Him you worship' - gratitude is where the claim of devotion gets tested daily.

morning.en: Everything wholesome on your table today is provision, and thanks is how it becomes worship.

night.en: You were fed today, body and more. Gratitude spoken now is worship completing the day.

gems.en: This fast is older than you: prophets and their peoples carried it before it reached your hands.
The fast's goal is not hunger but taqwa - the body steps back so awareness of Him steps forward.
Communities of faith before you fasted to be purified. You are inheriting, not inventing.

morning.en: Ramadan begins. The fast written for those before you is now written for you - taqwa is its aim.

night.en: The first day of Ramadan closes. Fasting was written for you, and its purpose - taqwa - has begun.

gems.en: No intermediary stands between you and Him - 'I am near' was said directly, to be taken directly.
No call to Him goes unanswered - though the shape and hour of the answer rest with His wisdom.
He answers when you call; the verse asks you to answer when He calls. The line runs both ways.
Prayer, obedience, and faith travel together - and right guidance is where they arrive.

morning.en: Before you ask anything today, the answer to the question of where He is has already come: near.

night.en: Whatever you whispered to Him today did not have far to travel. He was near the whole time.

gems.en: Fraud, deception, a deal without true consent - the verse calls all of it by one name: batil.
A bribe stains both hands - the one that offers it and the one that opens for it.
'While you know' is the sharpest phrase: wrongdoing done knowingly carries double weight.

morning.en: What you earn today is worth keeping clean - nothing taken falsely is worth what it costs.

night.en: What you refused to take today never becomes a weight you carry tonight.

gems.en: Earning a living and seeking Him were never rivals - even at Hajj, bounty and worship coexist.
At Arafat everyone stands the same - a rehearsal for the Day all wealth and rank fall away.
The night at Muzdalifah is dhikr under the open sky - stillness that seals what Arafat began.
Guidance was never earned - it was given while you were astray. Humility is remembering that.

morning.en: It is the Day of Arafah. Today's standing is remembrance: He guided you when you were astray.

night.en: Arafah closes with remembrance: you were once astray, and He guided you. That is tonight's thanks.

gems.en: There is a kind of person who holds nothing back - a whole life traded for His pleasure alone.
Whoever gives everything for Him finds His kindness was already larger than the sacrifice.
Some gave their very lives for this faith. The verse keeps their trade from being forgotten.

morning.en: On the day Imam Ali was born, the verse honors the one who sells his whole self for God's pleasure.

night.en: The birthday of Imam Ali closes - a life spent for God's pleasure, met by a Lord kind to His servants.

gems.en: The road to Paradise has always run through trials - yours are not a detour from it.
Poverty and hardship test one thing: whether what you lose can shake what you believe.
Even messengers were shaken to the point of crying out. Trembling is not the opposite of faith.
The verse's answer stands for you too: unquestionably, the help of Allah is near.

morning.en: Even messengers asked when His help would come - if today shakes you, you stand in honored company.

night.en: If today shook you, the verse's last word is for tonight: His help is near - nearer than it feels.

gems.en: The greatest verse in the Qur'an is a portrait of sovereignty: all knowledge, all power, His.
Ever-Living, Self-Sustaining: existence is maintained by One who never needs to rest from it.
Everything in your hands is held in trust - ownership was always His alone.
His Kursi spans the heavens and the earth, and keeping all of it costs Him nothing.

morning.en: The One holding your day is never overtaken by drowsiness - your full weight is safe on Him.

night.en: You are about to sleep; He never does. The heavens and the earth stay held all night without effort.

gems.en: Faith cannot be compelled into being genuine. Yours counts because you chose it.
Right and wrong were made distinguishable - by revelation, by reason, by the signs around you.
Belief begins with a refusal: false gods are turned down before the true One is held.
Whoever refuses falsehood and holds to Allah grips a handhold that has no breaking point.

morning.en: Truth stands clear on its own today - faith chosen freely is the only kind that counts.

night.en: You held the trustworthy handhold through this day. It has no break in it - not tonight, not ever.

gems.en: Charity multiplies like grain: one act of giving, up to seven hundred returns and counting.
He sees the intention inside each gift; no giving is ever rewarded by its surface alone.
Spending in His way has an aim: giving that carries guidance, justice, and mercy into the world.
A farmer buries seed trusting the harvest. Giving rests on the same trust - His promise to multiply.

morning.en: Whatever leaves your hand in His way today is a seed - and He multiplies seeds by the hundred.

night.en: Whatever you planted by giving today is now growing in ground you cannot see. Harvest is His promise.

gems.en: Giving that humiliates undoes itself. Kind words that keep a person's dignity rank higher.
He needs nothing from your charity - and He is patient with your imperfect giving as you learn.
Forgiving costs from the inside - you surrender your claim - which is why it counts as giving.

morning.en: A kind word today is worth more than an impressive gift that leaves hurt behind.

night.en: If all you managed today was kind speech and letting things go, the verse counts it as giving well.

gems.en: Wisdom joins understanding to right action - a blessing worth more than anything material.
Wisdom spills into everything - how you give, relate, worship, decide. That is 'much good.'
Hearing without reflection goes nowhere. The verse is for those who take truth into their core.

morning.en: Wisdom is given, not accumulated. The best judgment you will show today has a Giver.

night.en: If wisdom showed up anywhere in your day, it was given to you - and it was much good, as promised.

gems.en: Your capacity was consulted first: what He asks of you is exactly what you can carry.
What you earn today - good or ill - lands in your own account and no one else's.
'Do not blame us if we forget or err' - the verse itself makes room for your honest mistakes.
Pardon, forgiveness, mercy - the verse ends asking three depths of the same compassion.

morning.en: Today's load has already been measured against your capacity - He does not hand out too much.

night.en: Whatever you got wrong today, the verse's own words fit your mouth: pardon us, forgive us, have mercy.

gems.en: Adam's way back was carried by names: Muhammad and his family, taught to him by his Lord.
Adam's repentance was accepted - and with it the rule was set: sincere return is always received.
He is al-Tawwab: the One who accepts return after return. Coming back twice is not too many times.
Even the words of return came from his Lord. The urge to turn back is itself His assistance.

morning.en: Adam's story starts over with words his Lord gave him. Whatever yesterday held, today can begin again.

night.en: If anything today needs undoing, the One who taught Adam how to return is still al-Tawwab tonight.

gems.en: Glorifying Him at evening and morning brackets everything - the whole day is marked as His.
Evening and morning here carry the set prayers - the day's natural turns anchor its discipline.
Thresholds are potent - the turning of day into night is a door especially open to remembrance.

morning.en: 'Exalted is Allah when you reach the morning' - you have reached it, and the glorifying belongs to now.

night.en: You have reached the evening the verse names - and 'exalted is Allah' is the word for arriving here.

gems.en: Your origin is dust - everything in you that rose above it was raised by His purpose.
'Then suddenly you were human' - the verse compresses the miracle so you notice it is one.
From one dust, humanity spread everywhere - countless cultures, a single shared beginning.

morning.en: You began as dust and walked out into the world - today's moving, breathing self is His sign.

night.en: The body resting tonight was once dust - what it became in between is the sign the verse points to.

gems.en: Marriage is listed among His signs - a bond that points past itself to the One who designed it.
The rest found in a spouse shares its root with sakinah - the calm that descends at sacred moments.
Passion draws together, mercy keeps together - marriage stands on both, and both were placed by Him.
The verse closes on reflection - the depth of this sign opens only to those who think into it.

morning.en: Affection and mercy between spouses were placed by Him - what holds a home together is His sign.

night.en: If a home held tranquility today, the verse's word became quiet fact: He placed mercy between you.

gems.en: Thousands of tongues from one humanity - variety this deliberate is signature, not accident.
The spread of human color is designed beauty - difference in appearance is His intent, not error.
Human difference stands in the verse beside the heavens and the earth - the same order of sign.
These signs open to those of knowledge - seeing diversity truly takes understanding, not tolerance.

morning.en: Every language and shade of skin you meet today is listed with the heavens as one of His signs.

night.en: Today's many tongues and colors were signs all day - those of knowledge are the ones who read them.

gems.en: What you give a relative is not generosity but their due - family carries rights, not just warmth.
Relative, needy, traveler - the circle of giving is drawn wide enough to catch the vulnerable.
Giving that seeks His face needs no audience - the countenance of Allah is the intended reward.
The successful, by this verse, are not the accumulating - they are the ones who gave seeking Him.

morning.en: Some of today's obligations have faces: the relative, the needy, the traveler each hold a right.

night.en: What you gave today seeking His face was 'best' by His own word - such givers are named successful.

gems.en: Interest looks like growth and is not - with Allah, riba carries no increase at all.
Zakah given for His face multiplies - the verse calls such givers 'the multipliers' outright.
Intention divides the two increases - seeking His countenance is what makes giving grow.
One line carries an economy: exploitation barred, giving mandated, distribution turned just.

morning.en: Two kinds of increase part ways today: what grows through others' wealth, and what grows with Allah.

night.en: Only what left your hands for His sake today is still growing tonight - He multiplies what sought Him.

gems.en: The wind outside is no accident - a sign sent deliberately, carrying His continuous care.
His mercy is not abstract - rain, trade, and sustenance let you taste it in daily life.
Every venture that sails today moves at His command - He enables the enterprise and the connection.
The verse ends at 'perhaps you will be grateful' - His signs are meant to arrive at thanks.

morning.en: Today's winds are sent, not stray - bearers of good news, letting you taste His mercy on an ordinary day.

night.en: The day ran on what He sent - wind, mercy, bounty sought - and its hoped-for ending is your gratitude.

gems.en: Fanthur - look - is a command: His mercy in nature is meant to be contemplated, not just seen.
Dead earth turning green is set before you as visible proof of resurrection.
The verse states the link itself: the One reviving barren land will certainly give life to the dead.
Resurrection is one instance, not the limit - He is over all things competent, without exception.

morning.en: 'So observe the effects of the mercy of Allah' - today opens with an instruction to really look.

night.en: Rest tonight on the verse's own logic: the One who revives the earth after its death holds all power.

gems.en: Facing refusal, the prescription is sabr - not anger, not despair, but patience that outlasts.
His promise is haqq - certain reality, not hopeful thinking, whatever current appearances say.
Those without certainty may try to shake yours - their lack of yaqeen is not evidence against you.
'Let them not disquiet you' - composure before doubters is itself something the verse guards.

morning.en: The Prophet was told: be patient, the promise of Allah is truth - and that ground is open to you.

night.en: The promise did not weaken by nightfall - it is truth, and the uncertain could not move it.

gems.en: Hikmah is more than knowing - it is knowledge applied rightly, and it arrives as a gift given.
The foundation under wisdom is gratitude - the wise life begins at 'be grateful to Allah.'
Your thanks adds nothing to Him and everything to you - gratitude transforms its giver.
Ghaniyy and Hamid - He needs no praise and deserves all of it; worship never fills a lack in Him.

morning.en: Wisdom opens with thanks - Luqman was given hikmah, and its first instruction was gratitude to Allah.

night.en: If any thanks rose from you today, its benefit came home - whoever is grateful is grateful for himself.

gems.en: Luqman taught 'while instructing him' - gentle, continuous guidance is how faith passes at home.
The first thing worth handing down is pure tawhid - 'do not associate anything with Allah.'
Shirk is named a great injustice - it denies the Creator His right and bends reality itself.

morning.en: Luqman's first counsel to his son leads today: nothing shares the place that is Allah's alone.

night.en: A father's first counsel holds at day's end: Allah unshared, for shirk is the great injustice.

gems.en: 'Weakness upon weakness' - the Qur'an itself honors what your mother's body bore for you.
Even weaning's two years are noted - the slow work of raising a child sits inside divine wisdom.
Thanks to Allah and thanks to your parents arrive as one command - honoring them is part of worship.
Every bond has a horizon - 'to Me is the final destination' stands at the end of them all.

morning.en: 'Be grateful to Me and to your parents' - one command joins them, and today carries both debts.

night.en: The day's bonds and debts of gratitude all travel one direction: to Him is the final destination.

gems.en: Prayer leads Luqman's charge - not merely prayed but established: steady, attentive, kept up.
Faith faces outward too - promoting right and opposing wrong is a duty owed to your community.
'Be patient over what befalls you' - sabr is active endurance while doing good, not passive waiting.
Prayer, right, wrong resisted, patience - the verse calls these matters requiring determination.

morning.en: Luqman's charge fits a whole day: establish prayer, stand for right, bear what befalls you.

night.en: Whatever befell you today and was borne, the verse ranks that bearing among matters of resolve.

gems.en: Humility is physical before it is verbal - even the angle of your face toward people matters.
The strut is named and disliked - walking exultantly is vanity Allah explicitly rejects.
Mukhtal and fakhur - self-delusion and boasting feed each other, fooling their owner first.

morning.en: Part of today's faith is physical: no cheek turned in contempt, no exultant stride across the earth.

night.en: If today was walked humbly, it closed inside the verse - far from the self-deluded and boastful.

gems.en: Submitting the face means the whole of you - identity and direction turned toward Allah.
Surrender travels with excellence - submission 'while a doer of good' is the verse's full picture.
Al-urwah al-wuthqa does not snap - the handhold of submission and good deeds never fails its holder.
Every unsettled matter is already addressed - to Allah is the outcome of all affairs.

morning.en: Whoever submits his face to Allah while doing good has grasped the surest handhold - open again today.

night.en: Whatever stayed unresolved tonight is still traveling - to Allah is the outcome of all matters.

gems.en: Trees as pens, seas as ink, and still no end - His knowledge outruns every instrument of writing.
The image is built to stagger - pictures stretched to their limit to hint at the limitless.
The vastness is not idle - Aziz and Hakim: knowledge acting as unbeatable might and perfect wisdom.

morning.en: If every tree were a pen and seven seas the ink, His words would not run out - today sits in that vastness.

night.en: Today spent hours, energy, words. His words are not spent - seven seas of ink could not exhaust them.

gems.en: Faith shows in the response - real belief moves the body when His verses reach it.
Sajda is the heart's submission made visible - the believer's natural answer to divine truth.
The forehead goes down and the tongue lifts up - prostration and praise travel together.
Arrogance keeps a person upright at the wrong moment - freedom from pride is what lets you bow.

morning.en: The verse sketches those who truly believe: reminded, they fall in prostration, praising, unproud.

night.en: The day's last prostrations match the verse's portrait: reminded, bowing, praising, free of pride.

gems.en: Some reward is deliberately concealed - delights no soul has ever seen, known, or imagined.
Qurrat a'yun - coolness of the eyes: contentment complete enough to retire every sorrow.
The hidden joy is recompense, not chance - the verse ties it to what they used to do.
No created being - human, angel, or jinn - can picture it; the surprise is part of the gift.

morning.en: No soul knows the delight kept hidden - what quiet good deeds earn is a secret still being kept.

night.en: If good was done quietly today, its reward keeps the same style: hidden, waiting, beyond guessing.

gems.en: The leaders of the verse guide by His command - such guidance is appointed, not self-made.
Their station arrived through sabr - endurance under trial is how spiritual weight is earned.
They held yaqin, not opinion - certainty of His signs kept their guidance firm.
Bi-amrina - by Our command: their guidance transmitted His instruction, not personal preference.

morning.en: In the verse, rank follows endurance: they were made leaders 'when they were patient.'

night.en: What was endured today is not wasted material - in the verse, patience came before leadership.

gems.en: The pattern is a person - the Prophet's life is the Qur'an's teaching lived out, there to follow.
The example comes with its condition - it is for 'whoever hopes in Allah'; hope is the doorway.
Belief in the Last Day keeps the example urgent - accountability fuels the following.
'And remembers Allah often' completes the portrait - constant remembrance shapes the follower.

morning.en: An excellent pattern already exists for today - the Messenger of Allah, for whoever hopes in Him.

night.en: Wherever today resembled him, even slightly, it followed the pattern the verse calls excellent.

gems.en: Sidq at this level is a covenant kept with Allah - truthfulness proven by cost, not by claim.
'Some fulfilled their vow' - devotion carried to its completion, the covenant honored to the end.
'Some await' - readiness is also faithfulness; the committed stay steady before their turn.
Circumstances shift and hypocrites shift with them - the truthful altered nothing at all.

morning.en: On the day of Imam Ali's martyrdom, the verse speaks its words: men true to what they promised Allah.

night.en: The night of Imam Ali's martyrdom closes on the verse he lived: true to the promise, altering nothing.

gems.en: Tawakkul is acting while entrusting outcomes to Him - effort and reliance in one motion.
Wakil is His self-declared role - He alone is enough to manage what is beyond you.
A handful of words holds a whole theology - the verse's brevity is itself Qur'anic eloquence.

morning.en: One instruction covers everything on today's list: rely upon Allah - sufficient is He as Disposer of affairs.

night.en: The affairs you could not finish today have a Disposer - and sufficient is Allah as Wakil.

gems.en: The home in the verse is a place of honor and cultivation - dignified presence, not confinement.
Ayat al-Tathir states His will: impurity removed from the Ahlul Bayt, purification complete.
'People of the House' is a designation, not a description - the Prophet's nearest, in special rank.
The verse turns from Jahiliyyah's display - the old ignorance that reduced women is left behind.

morning.en: It is the martyrdom of Sayyida Fatima - the verse of purification stands over her house today.

night.en: The night of Sayyida Fatima's martyrdom closes under the verse's word for her house: purified, completely.

gems.en: The verse pairs men and women through every virtue - His reward reaches both alike.
The ten named virtues sketch a whole life - from inward faith to fasting to guarded modesty.
The list rises to its crown: remembering Allah often - the virtue that carries all the others.
For their keepers He has prepared two things by name: forgiveness, and a great reward.

morning.en: Ten virtues, each named twice - for men and for women alike - and all of them are open today.

night.en: Whichever of the ten virtues today touched, the same preparation stands: forgiveness and great reward.

gems.en: 'O you who have believed' - the command arrives wrapped in honor; He addresses you by your faith.
Dhikr is the base practice - keeping Him present in consciousness through everything else.
'Much' is part of the command - occasional remembrance was never the target; abundance is.
Dhikr holds when circumstances swing - the anchor that keeps faith alive through anything.

morning.en: One command sizes the day: remember Allah with much remembrance - dhikr keeping pace with the hours.

night.en: If His name surfaced through your day - in ease, in stress, in passing - the command was being kept.

gems.en: Yusalli alaykum - He sends His own blessing on the believers, the very term used for salawat.
Unseen support is at work - His angels ask mercy and forgiveness for the faithful.
The blessing has a direction - out of the darknesses, into the light; that is its stated purpose.
Rahim here is the special mercy - the nearness He keeps for those who believe.

morning.en: He confers blessing upon you, and His angels pray for you - the day begins already accompanied.

night.en: The verse's movement continues overnight - out of darknesses into light, and He is ever Merciful.

gems.en: Salam is the arrival word - honor and safety spoken by the Lord of the worlds Himself.
The day they meet Him is stated as real - meeting Allah is the journey's actual destination.
Ajran karima - a reward not only great but noble, dignified as its Giver is generous.
A'adda - prepared: the reward already exists, made ready in advance rather than pending.

morning.en: The final greeting is already chosen - 'Peace,' on the Day they meet Him - and today walks toward it.

night.en: One more day of the approach has closed - toward a greeting already decided: Peace.

gems.en: Salawat begins above - Allah Himself blesses the Prophet, setting his rank at the highest source.
The angels join in - the whole heavenly realm participates in honoring him.
'O you who believe, bless him' - the salawat is a command for the faithful, not a suggestion.
Taslima - complete: the greeting is meant to be wholehearted, given fully rather than rushed.

morning.en: Before today asks anything of you, heaven models one act: Allah and His angels bless the Prophet.

night.en: A salawat tonight joins something already unending - Allah and His angels bless the Prophet.

gems.en: Saba's gardens were a sign in their own home - prosperity itself can be an ayah of divine favor.
Right and left, garden and garden - abundance arranged with balance, sustenance on every side.
Provision came with etiquette - eat, and be grateful to Him; enjoyment and thanks travel together.
'A good land and a forgiving Lord' - material blessing and spiritual mercy named in one breath.

morning.en: Saba woke between two gardens and one instruction: eat of your Lord's provision, and be grateful to Him.

night.en: The day's provision has been eaten - and the verse's pairing remains: a good land, a forgiving Lord.

gems.en: Rizq is measured from one source - He extends and restricts by wisdom, never by accident.
'Whatever you spend, He will compensate it' - generosity operates under a divine guarantee.
Khayr al-Raziqin - no other source matches His providing in quality or reliability.
He provides, you spend, He replaces - generosity moves inside a circuit of blessing He maintains.

morning.en: Provision widens and narrows by His wisdom - and whatever you spend today, He will compensate it.

night.en: Whatever was given in His cause today sits inside the promise: He will compensate it, Best of Providers.

gems.en: An error lands on the one who makes it - your choices today are yours to answer for.
The Prophet steered by revelation, not opinion - guidance worth following today has that source.
Samee' and Qareeb - whatever you say to Him today is heard, and heard from close by.
Allah's own messenger spoke as a servant needing guidance - dependence on Him is no demotion.

morning.en: If guidance finds you today, its source is what He revealed - and He is Hearing and near.

night.en: If any step today found guidance, the verse names its source: what your Lord reveals - and He stayed near.

gems.en: Faqir to Allah is your standing title - each breath and heartbeat today is His continuous gift.
Al-Ghani - He needs nothing you bring; your obedience today adds nothing to His perfection.
Al-Hamid is praiseworthy in essence, not just in gifts - praise of Him stands even in lean seasons.
Your poverty set beside His wealth is the true map - relating to Him rightly starts from that gap.

morning.en: You carry your need to the One who has none - every breath today is drawn from His sufficiency.

night.en: You brought nothing but need to this day, and He carried it - Ghani in wealth, Hamid in essence.

gems.en: Mercy that He opens cannot be intercepted - what reaches you today came unblocked from Him.
What He withholds, none can release - a delay in your life sits under His sovereignty, not chance.
Al-Aziz - the might behind today's mercy is absolute, and nothing created can overpower it.
Al-Hakim - what He grants and what He holds back both pass through perfect wisdom first.

morning.en: Any door of mercy He opens today stays open - no power in creation can shut what He has sent.

night.en: Tonight's account is simple: what came, He opened; what did not, He withheld - and He is Mighty, Wise.

gems.en: Reciting His Book is itself worship - the verse lists it first in the trade that cannot fail.
Prayer kept and provision shared - the trade runs on worship and generosity together.
Some giving belongs in public to invite others; some belongs in secret to guard sincerity.
Worldly wealth decays - what is placed with Him is the one investment that cannot go under.

morning.en: A trade stands open today - recitation, prayer, and giving - whose profit the verse says cannot perish.

night.en: If today held recitation, prayer, or giving, your stake sits in the trade that will never go under.

gems.en: Al-hazan - sorrow, anxiety, regret - is named as removable; in Paradise it is simply gone.
Those in Paradise still credit His forgiveness - Ghafur is remembered as what carried them in.
Shakur - He magnifies small acts into lasting reward; nothing sincere you do today is too little.

morning.en: The people of Paradise will praise Him for removing sorrow - grief has an expiry written for the faithful.

night.en: The people of Paradise look back on sorrow as a thing removed - a horizon worth carrying to sleep.

gems.en: The universe is not self-running - yumsiku: He holds it, moment by moment, including this one.
No backup holds the heavens if He let go - what stands, stands by Him alone.
The One with power to drop the sky is Halim - forbearing, delaying punishment, accepting return.

morning.en: The sky over your day does not hold itself - He keeps it, actively, and nothing else could.

night.en: The heavens stay up tonight because He holds them - Forbearing and Forgiving while He does.

gems.en: The verse opens by clearing His name of all deficiency - what He makes flows from perfection.
Male and female, day and night - creation runs on pairs, and balance is built in, not accidental.
'And what they do not know' - creation keeps dimensions past your knowledge, and the verse says so.
What earth grows, yourselves, and the unknown - the pairing spans every register of existence.

morning.en: Glory to the One who made all things in pairs - the balance running through today is designed.

night.en: The pairs ran through today - earth's growth, people, the unknown - made by One free of all lack.

gems.en: Salam arrives as speech, not just a state - being addressed by Him is itself the gift.
Not relayed through angels - the Peace comes from the Merciful Lord Himself, personally given.
Comforts are described first; the greeting crowns them - communion with Him is Paradise's peak.

morning.en: Past all of today's noise, Paradise's greeting is on record: one word, Peace, from a Merciful Lord.

night.en: The day ends toward the word Paradise's people will hear: Peace, spoken by a Merciful Lord.

gems.en: Ibrahim did not ask merely for a child but a righteous one - the quality mattered over the having.
Ibrahim's faith was unwavering, and still he voiced his need - the two coexist without shame.
The dua comes after the fire and the migration - great gifts often follow the greatest tests.

morning.en: Ibrahim's asking put righteousness before everything else - a shape your own requests today can take.

night.en: Rabbi hab li min as-salihin - Ibrahim's words for family are ready if tonight's dua reaches for them.

gems.en: The ransom was His provision, not Ibrahim's - the test measured willingness, never bloodshed.
The ram is called azim for its role, not its size - greatness here is assigned by the moment.
The ransom replaced human sacrifice for good - the sanctity of human life is written into this rite.
Every Eid al-Adha flows from this verse - one act of submission, commemorated across generations.

morning.en: Eid al-Adha begins. Today remembers the ransom - Allah Himself provided what Ibrahim's test required.

night.en: Eid al-Adha closes. What He asked of Ibrahim was willingness, and what He gave back was the ransom.

gems.en: After 950 years of preaching, Nuh's sincere call was answered - length of struggle did not void it.
Ni'ma al-mujibun - when a sincere servant calls, His answering is the best answering there is.
Nuh called Him directly - nadana - and that straight line from servant to Lord is yours to use.

morning.en: Nuh called, and the answer came from the best of responders - your calls today go to the same One.

night.en: If you called Him today, the call went where Nuh's went - to the best of responders.

gems.en: Mubarak - the Book carries blessing, and the verse ties that barakah to those who engage it.
The stated purpose is tadabbur - recitation without reflection stops short of why it came down.
The verse names who takes the reminder: ulul albab - those willing to bring their intellect to it.
As dhikr, the Book awakens what was forgotten - your purpose, origin, and destination.

morning.en: The Qur'an you open today was sent for pondering - tadabbur is the purpose written into it.

night.en: A verse pondered slowly tonight fulfills the Book's stated purpose - it was sent down for that.

gems.en: The address is affectionate before it instructs - 'My servants,' then the call to taqwa.
Ahsanu here, hasana here - doing good collects some of its return in this world, before the next.
His earth is spacious - where faith cannot breathe, moving is named as an open option.
Bi-ghayri hisab - the patient are repaid without account; no formula caps what sabr earns.

morning.en: 'O My servants,' He begins - and the patience today asks of you carries reward beyond any counting.

night.en: If today asked for patience and got it, the verse's promise applies: reward given without account.

gems.en: Bil-haqq - the Book carries truth without distortion; what it asks of you rests on solid ground.
Ikhlas strips worship of spectators - no show, no worldly angle, one intended audience.
Ad-din is wider than ritual - belief, worship, and daily conduct all belong inside the submission.

morning.en: Truth came down so worship could be pure - what you do for Him today needs no other audience.

night.en: What was done purely for Him today needed no witness - sincerity was the instruction from the start.

gems.en: Bil-haqq - the cosmos is not play; purpose and accountability are built into its making.
Yukawwir - night coils over day with astronomical precision; the transition you watch is governed.
Li-ajalin musamma - each celestial body runs a fixed term; the universe keeps divine appointments.
Aziz and Ghaffar together - the might is absolute, and it chooses forgiveness for those who turn.

morning.en: Day was wrapped over night this morning - the same precise hand runs the sun, the moon, and your hours.

night.en: Night has been wrapped over day again, as the verse says - the hand doing it is Mighty and Ever-Forgiving.

gems.en: The transgressors are still addressed as 'My servants' - sin does not revoke the relationship.
La taqnatu is a command - giving up on His mercy is disobedience, whatever the sin's size.
'All sins, together' - jamee'an - the verse states it absolutely and lists no exceptions.
Ghafur and Rahim close the verse - forgiveness and mercy are not moods of His but names.

morning.en: Even those who have wronged themselves are still 'My servants' - despair is the one thing He forbids here.

night.en: Whatever today added to your account, the door stands as stated: He forgives all sins, together.

gems.en: Qanit in the night hours - devotion no one sees carries a sincerity daylight cannot prove.
Yahdharu al-akhira - living aware that this life is temporary keeps accountability in view.
Fear and hope travel paired - wary of the Hereafter, hopeful of His mercy, neither one alone.
The knower and the non-knower are declared unequal - knowledge of Him raises spiritual rank.

morning.en: Knowledge sets ranks today - the one who knows Him and the one who does not are not the same.

night.en: The night hours the verse honors are here - devotion now, unseen by anyone, is the sincerity it praises.

gems.en: The rope of Allah is a lifeline already lowered - covenant, Qur'an, faith - yours to grip today.
'All together' is part of the command - the rope is held in company, not in scattered solitude.
Hearts once enemies became brothers - unity is His gift to be thanked for, not a human trophy.
Rescue came at the pit's very edge - remembering how close it was keeps the gratitude alive.

morning.en: One rope holds today - His. And the hearts holding it beside you were joined by His favor, not by chance.

night.en: The rope held through this day - and the hearts He joined to yours are His favor, worth thanks tonight.

gems.en: Calling to goodness is not a specialist's job - it is a community's work, and you are inside it.
Standing for right and against wrong is a trust - carried mostly in small, ordinary moments.
The successful ones here are the callers to good - success measured by contribution, not by gain.

morning.en: Some must call to what is good - the verse makes it shared work, and today offers you your share of it.

night.en: If you moved anything toward good today - a word, a stand, a kindness - you stood among the callers.

gems.en: Sari'u - hasten. Forgiveness is approached at a run, not saved for some quieter season.
What is prepared spans the heavens and the earth - generosity too wide for the mind to fence in.
Paradise stands prepared for the people of taqwa - the ones who live it, not just say it.
Faith here moves like a race - forgiveness and Paradise are pursued, not passively awaited.

morning.en: Forgiveness is not waiting for you to wander over - the verse says hasten, and today is ground to cover.

night.en: However far you moved toward His forgiveness today, it counts as racing - and the garden is prepared.

gems.en: After a setback the verse speaks first to the inside - strength there outweighs the circumstances.
The higher ground promised is not material - faith holds it whatever the scoreboard says.
'If you are believers' - the promise leans on faith kept active, especially through the trial.

morning.en: Whatever yesterday cost, today opens with the verse's double command: do not weaken, and do not grieve.

night.en: The two commands outlast the daylight: no weakening, no grieving - faith keeps the higher ground tonight.

gems.en: The message was built to outlast the messenger - faith stands on the One who sent him.
At Uhud a rumor tested where faith was anchored - anchored in Allah, it does not turn on its heels.
Turning back harms Allah nothing at all - faith was always for your benefit, never His need.
The grateful here are those who keep faith through grief - and Allah Himself promises their reward.

morning.en: On the day the ummah lost the Prophet, this verse held it steady: faith rests on his Lord, who remains.

night.en: The day of the Prophet's departure closes as the verse taught: grief held with gratitude, faith standing.

gems.en: Prophets were never alone in the struggle - devoted companions carried it with them in every era.
No lost heart, no weakness, no surrender - endurance holds on all three fronts at once.
Allah declares love for the steadfast - patience is among the few things He names His love for.

morning.en: Whole companies stood with their prophets through affliction and did not weaken - you walk in their line.

night.en: If you did not give in today - in heart, strength, or spirit - you kept the company Allah says He loves.

gems.en: The Prophet's leniency after failure was Allah's mercy in action - softness given, not weakness.
Harshness scatters people - even truth, spoken hard-hearted, empties the room around it.
After others' mistakes the sequence is: pardon them, seek forgiveness for them, still consult them.
Deliberate, decide, then hand the outcome to Him - tawakkul begins where your part ends.

morning.en: The Prophet's gentleness was Allah's mercy at work - gentleness in you today draws from the same source.

night.en: Where you chose gentle over harsh today, you kept people near - as mercy kept them near the Prophet.

gems.en: With His aid, no opposition is a majority - divine support outweighs every count against you.
If His support were withdrawn, nothing could substitute - every other reliance borrows from Him.
The verse ends in a command: rely on Allah alone. Trust placed there is never misplaced.

morning.en: Today's arithmetic is simple: with His help no one can overcome you; without it, no other help exists.

night.en: Whatever carried you through today was His aid - and on Him the believers rest their weight tonight.

gems.en: Martyrdom is not an ending - it is passage into a higher life, alive with their Lord.
Their provision never stopped - sustenance continues with their Lord, in a realm above this one.
The verse corrects the eye - what grief sees as an ending, He declares to be life.

morning.en: It is Ashura. Over Karbala this verse stands guard: the ones killed in His cause are alive with their Lord.

night.en: Ashura closes. The mourned of Karbala are not gone - alive with their Lord, receiving provision.

gems.en: His oneness rests on the strongest testimony possible: His own. No truth is better attested.
Divine, angelic, human - the testimony to His oneness comes signed from all three realms.
He maintains all of creation 'in justice' - fairness is built into how the universe is held.
Absolute might, paired with perfect wisdom - His power never moves without reason.

morning.en: Today's surest fact was witnessed by Allah Himself: no god but Him, upholding all in justice.

night.en: The witness that opened the day still stands tonight: no god but He, and all things held in justice.

gems.en: La-tublawunna - you will surely be tested. The trial is a certainty foretold, not a surprise.
Harsh words about your faith were foretold too - abuse is part of the believer's road, not a detour.
Sabr joined to taqwa is the verse's answer - a resolve it ranks among the greatest of matters.

morning.en: The verse promises testing in wealth and self as certainty - a hard day arrives already explained.

night.en: If today tested wealth or self, the response was named long ago: patience and taqwa, matters of resolve.

gems.en: Heavens, earth, the turn of night and day - creation is a text kept open for the thoughtful.
Uli al-albab see past the surface - in the Qur'an, intellect is faith's ally, not its rival.
Night and day have traded places on schedule your whole life - a rhythm pointing to its Designer.

morning.en: The sky above today and the daylight crossing it are signs - addressed to anyone willing to think.

night.en: The night that just replaced the day is itself one of the signs, addressed to your understanding.

gems.en: He answered the prayer Himself: no worker's work is lost. Every good deed today is kept.
'You are of one another' - male or female, worth is measured by the deed, not the gender.
Exile, harm, loss borne for His sake - every form the sacrifice takes is seen and counted.
Misdeeds removed, gardens with rivers flowing beneath - with Him is the best of rewards.

morning.en: Nothing done for Him today can go missing: 'Never will I allow to be lost the work of any worker.'

night.en: Nothing you worked at for Him today has gone missing tonight - He preserves every worker's work.

gems.en: Persevere, endure, hold the post, keep taqwa - commitment deepening one level at a time.
Sabiru is patience that outlasts - endurance measured against the difficulty's own stamina.
Rabitu is the guard who stays at his post while tired - vigilance kept after freshness fades.
All four commands run toward the one destination the verse names: falah, genuine success.

morning.en: The verse hands today four commands: persevere, endure, remain stationed, and keep taqwa.

night.en: A day of holding on closes - and the verse ties that endurance, with taqwa, to success itself.

gems.en: Every throne, office, and authority you meet today is on loan from the Owner of Sovereignty.
Empires rise and fall by His decree - no power today is bigger than the One who assigns it.
Dignity is not issued by status or wealth. Honor comes from Him - and no one else can revoke it.
'In Your hand is all good' - whatever good reaches you today left His hand before it found yours.

morning.en: Whatever powers loom over today, sovereignty has one Owner - and in His hand is all good.

night.en: The day ends as it began: sovereignty His, honor His to give, and all good in His hand.

gems.en: Love for Allah is not claimed; it is walked. Each step behind the Prophet today is the proof.
The exchange is real: you follow, He loves and forgives. Human effort is met with divine grace.
Following the Prophet arrives somewhere specific: forgiveness, from the Forgiving and Merciful.

morning.en: Love for Allah has a proof today: following His Prophet - and the verse promises love answered back.

night.en: Whatever of the Prophet's way you kept today, the promise stands: His love and forgiveness answer it.

gems.en: His power at work in someone else's life is reason to ask for your own need with confidence.
Zechariah asked for goodness in his children, not just children - the quality was the prayer.
'From You' - a child, and every real gift, comes from His presence, not merely from circumstance.
The prayer closes on certainty: He is the Hearer of supplication - no ask of Him goes unheard.

morning.en: Zechariah saw what Allah gave Mary and asked for his own. What you see of His power is an invitation.

night.en: Whatever you asked Him for today reached the Hearer of supplication - Zechariah's certainty is yours to keep.

gems.en: Wonder at a promise that defies the odds is human - Zechariah voiced it and was still answered.
The barriers were real and named - age and barrenness - and neither one changed the outcome.
'Such is Allah; He does what He wills' - physical limits are facts, but they are not the final word.

morning.en: Zechariah counted the impossibilities - age, barrenness - and the answer held: Allah does what He wills.

night.en: Whatever looked impossible today sits under the same ruling that answered Zechariah: He does what He wills.

gems.en: Your features and capacities were decided with wisdom - nothing about you is accidental.
From a single cell to a whole person - the womb's quiet work was His design the entire way.
The Mighty is also the Wise: the power that made you never once acted without purpose.

morning.en: You were formed in the womb however He willed - with might, with wisdom, entirely on purpose.

night.en: Formed by the Mighty, designed by the Wise - the body resting tonight was His work first.

gems.en: When truth was challenged, the Prophet brought his family - the Ahlul Bayt stand where truth stands.
Certainty shows in what it will stake. The Prophet was ready to put everything behind the truth.
After clear knowledge arrives, endless argument stops being a search - the verse marks that line.

morning.en: It is Mubahala. Challenged after clear knowledge, the Prophet answered by bringing his family forward.

night.en: Mubahala closes: the Prophet's proof was the people he brought - his nearest, standing beside the truth.

gems.en: Al-birr is not reached from surplus - it begins where the giving starts to cost you something real.
Whatever you give today, and why, is fully known to Him - no gift of yours goes unregistered.
'From what you love' - the attachment is the point. Letting it go is what gives the giving weight.

morning.en: Righteousness has a price the verse names plainly: something you love, given while you still love it.

night.en: If anything you loved left your hands today, the verse says that is where the good you seek begins.

gems.en: 'You will remember what I say' - truth outlasts its rejection, even when the rejecters learn late.
Ufawwidu amri ila Allah - the believer spoke it after his duty was done; entrustment follows effort.
Basir bil-ibad - your struggle and sincerity are fully seen, and that seeing is also comfort.

morning.en: 'I entrust my affair to Allah' - words first said under threat, and they fit any day's uncertainty.

night.en: The believer's words close today well: I entrust my affair to Allah, and He is Seeing of His servants.

gems.en: The ground holding you today was made qarar - stable, settled, fitted for your living.
Fa-ahsana suwarakum - your form was not merely made but perfected; the design carries His care.
At-tayyibat - provision comes not just sufficient but good and pure; generosity is in the quality.
Rabb al-alamin - the One who settled your earth is Lord of every world, not a local deity.

morning.en: Steady ground, a roofed sky, a perfected form, pure provision - today runs on four named gifts.

night.en: Today ran on the settled earth and the good provision He named - blessed is Allah, Lord of the worlds.

gems.en: Al-Hayy - life without beginning or end; all creation passes, and He remains.
Fad'uhu mukhlisin - the call to Him is meant clean: no hypocrisy, no performance, just asking.
Alhamdulillah belongs to Him exclusively - no created force earns the praise that is His.

morning.en: Today's calls have one address that never expires - Al-Hayy, the Ever-Living, no deity but He.

night.en: The day ends as the verse does: praise to Allah, Lord of the worlds - the Ever-Living outlasts every day.

gems.en: The declaration plus the staying - to those two together, angels bring glad tidings.
Thumma istaqamu - the 'then' matters; belief is the start, consistency is the evidence.
At the most vulnerable moment, angels descend on the steadfast - reassurance arrives right then.
Do not fear, do not grieve, receive glad tidings - past, present, and future each answered.

morning.en: 'Our Lord is Allah' is the declaration; today offers what the verse prizes next - remaining steady on it.

night.en: If today was one more day of holding to 'Our Lord is Allah,' the angels' three comforts stand ahead.

gems.en: Three strands make speech its best: the call to Him, righteous work, and an open Muslim identity.
Da'wa is not a specialist's job - calling to Allah is named the noblest thing a voice can do.
The verse welds the calling to the doing - words about Him gain weight from conduct behind them.
'Innani min al-muslimin' - the identity is said plainly and without apology; belonging is voiced.

morning.en: No speech today can outrank this: inviting to Allah, backed by right action and an unhidden identity.

night.en: If any words today invited toward Him - said or lived - the verse ranks them above all other speech.

gems.en: La tastawi - good and evil are not equivalents; the scale between them is fixed, not negotiable.
Idfa' billati hiya ahsan - the prescribed answer to evil is not payback but something better.
Answered with excellence, enmity can become devoted friendship - moral force does what force cannot.

morning.en: Good and evil do not weigh the same - meeting the worse with the better is the verse's own counsel.

night.en: If today held an answer better than the wrong it met, the verse says that is how enmity melts.

gems.en: The earth is called khashi'a, humbled - the word for humble hearts; creation models submission.
Rain lands and the dead ground quivers and grows - His provision carries life-from-death power.
The verse draws the line itself: He who revives the dead earth is Giver of Life to the dead.
The sign closes in certainty - He is over all things competent, and revival is within that power.

morning.en: Today's stilled earth is the verse's sign in waiting - one rain from Him and it stirs, swells, and lives.

night.en: The earth that stirred at His rain is tonight's assurance - the One who revives it revives the dead.

gems.en: What you do is done first to yourself - righteousness is for your soul, evil is against it.
The wording is emphatic - your Lord is not ever unjust to His servants; every verdict is fair.
No one else carries your sins, and no one else collects your good - the return is all your own.
Even in judgment He calls you His servant - an honored relation, guarded by His perfect justice.

morning.en: Every deed you choose today lands on your own ledger - good feeds your soul, evil weighs against it.

night.en: Whatever you did today has already found its address - your own soul. And your Lord wrongs no one.

gems.en: The sky, the seasons, the working cosmos - the horizons hold His signs in plain, observable view.
You are evidence too - consciousness, design, the soul's pull toward truth are signs within you.
The showing has a destination - signs keep arriving until the truth stands clear beyond doubt.
Past every sign stands the surest proof named here - your Lord Himself, Witness over all things.

morning.en: The signs promised here surround your day - in the horizons out there, and within your own self.

night.en: Signs filled this day, outer and inner - and over all of it, your Lord remained Witness.

gems.en: Iman inside, amal outside - the verse asks for both, and neither substitutes for the other.
Ghayr mamnun - the reward neither pauses nor runs out; worldly joys thin, this one does not.
The promise lands right after the warning - His justice and His mercy are printed side by side.

morning.en: Belief carried into deeds - that pairing today feeds a reward the verse calls unending.

night.en: If belief moved into action today, the verse's word for its reward is uninterrupted - no expiry, no gap.

gems.en: Fatir - He did not reshape what was there; He originated existence itself, out of nothing.
Mates from yourselves, pairs among the cattle - companionship is a pattern He wove into creation.
Nothing is like unto Him - every image the mind builds falls short; He is beyond all likeness.
Utterly beyond comparison, yet fully attentive - the Hearing, the Seeing misses nothing of you.

morning.en: The One you turn to today is the Originator of everything - beyond likeness, yet Hearing and Seeing you.

night.en: Nothing in this day resembled Him, and nothing in it escaped Him - the Hearing, the Seeing was near.

gems.en: Much of His care never announces itself - Latif is kindness at work beneath your awareness.
Provision differs by His wisdom, not by whim - what reaches each servant is measured to benefit.
The gentleness is backed by strength - Al-Qawi, Al-Aziz, able to provide and beyond challenge.

morning.en: Latif - His kindness moves gently through today, providing in ways too subtle for you to trace.

night.en: Some of today's provision arrived unnoticed - that is Latif, gentle with His servants, still at work.

gems.en: The one wage asked is mawaddah fi'l-qurba - in Shia understanding, love for the Ahlul Bayt.
The Prophet took no worldly payment for the message - guidance is given freely, never sold.
Whoever earns one good deed finds its goodness increased - His return outgrows your effort.
Ghafur and Shakur - He forgives what went wrong and treasures even the smallest good you did.

morning.en: On the birth of Imam Husayn, the verse's asked-for wage has a face: love for the Prophet's near kin.

night.en: The child born on this night is, in Shia reading, of the qurba named here - love the one wage asked.

gems.en: No past disqualifies a sincere return - tawba's door stands open to every servant who turns back.
Pardon here is active - misdeeds and their traces erased by mercy, not merely overlooked.
He knows what you do - hidden and shown alike; nothing sits outside the accounting.

morning.en: Today runs under an open door - He accepts repentance from His servants and pardons misdeeds.

night.en: He saw all of today - and the same verse that says He knows says He accepts and He pardons.

gems.en: Relief keeps His timing - rain has come precisely when people had stopped expecting it.
His mercy is not stored but spread - laid out across creation, within reach of all.
Al-Wali, Al-Hamid - the Guardian who protects you is the same One all praise belongs to.

morning.en: Despair has an expiry in this verse - He sends the rain after hope runs out, and spreads His mercy.

night.en: If today felt rainless, the verse keeps its order - the sending comes after the despair, not before.

gems.en: Sabr and pardon together - endurance joined to mercy is where the verse locates real strength.
Forgiving is not the soft option - the verse ranks it among matters demanding firm resolve.
Answering back is permitted first - then the verse honors those who rise past it to forgive.

morning.en: The strong choice today may be the quiet one - patience joined to forgiveness is called true resolve.

night.en: If you endured and let something go today, the verse already named it - a matter of determination.

gems.en: Dominion of the heavens and the earth is His - He creates what He wills, consulting no one.
Daughters granted here, sons granted there - each child arrives as a gift of His will and wisdom.
'To whom He wills' repeats - who is given children, and which, was never in human hands.

morning.en: The shape of every family is His assignment - He gives daughters to whom He wills, and He gives sons.

night.en: The household you have was granted, not chanced - He gives to whom He wills, and this was His giving.

gems.en: The Qur'an is named ruh, spirit - what the soul is to your body, revelation is to your heart.
Before revelation the Prophet knew neither Book nor faith - prophethood is given, not self-achieved.
He made it a light - ignorance, doubt, and misguidance are darknesses that do not survive its reach.
The path the Prophet guides to is straight - direct and clear, with no winding detours in it.

morning.en: The Book near you today is called a ruh and a light - sent to bring hearts to life and guide them.

night.en: The lamp is still lit tonight - a light by which He guides whom He wills of His servants.

gems.en: Fastamsik is a tightened grip - revelation held with conviction that opposition cannot pry loose.
The assurance was the Prophet's - whatever opponents said, his path ran straight to Allah.
The anchor named is revelation - not opinion, custom, or approval, which drift with their era.
Allah's own 'Indeed, you are' steadied the Prophet with certainty no human doubt could shake.

morning.en: The Prophet was told to grip revelation and not let go - that same handhold sits within reach today.

night.en: What was revealed to him has reached you - tonight it is still the firmest thing there is to hold.

gems.en: The Day's address opens with 'O My servants' - intimacy placed before the reassurance begins.
'No fear concerning you' - for those who lived as His, the great dread of that Day is lifted.
Nor will they grieve - past regrets dissolved along with every alarm about what comes next.
For the righteous, the most feared Day becomes the day both fear and grief are ended.

morning.en: A Day is coming when He calls His servants free of fear and grief - today can be lived toward it.

night.en: The words await His servants at the end of everything - no fear this Day, and no grief.

gems.en: The cosmos is set to serve you - an honored standing in creation you did nothing to earn.
'All from Him' - every blessing and resource in use today traces to a single origin.
The signs unlock at the level of thought - reflection turns scenery into evidence.

morning.en: Everything serving you today - sun, sea, the ground underfoot - was subjected for you, all from Him.

night.en: A day spent inside His subjected world ends - those who gave it thought saw signs all through it.

gems.en: Basair is sight for the inner eye - reality read at its depth instead of its appearances.
Guidance and mercy travel together - direction for the path, compassion for the one walking it.
The fullest yield goes to the people of yaqin - certainty deepens what the same pages give.

morning.en: The Qur'an offers more than information today - basair, insight that sees past the surface of things.

night.en: Guidance and mercy settle tonight where the verse directs them - on hearts that hold certainty.

gems.en: Nothing about existence is frivolous - creation came with haqq, meaning built into its structure.
Recompense is counted per soul - what you earned is yours to answer for, and only yours.
'They will not be wronged' - no good deed slips the record, no fault written larger than it was.

morning.en: The world you step into today was built with truth - purpose and moral order are in its frame.

night.en: Today's earnings rest with a Judge who wrongs no one - the fairness of the count is guaranteed.

gems.en: Excellence toward parents is enjoined by Allah - their right over you was set by Him, not custom.
Carried in hardship, delivered in hardship - your mother's sacrifice receives its own mention.
Thirty months of carrying and weaning - maternal devotion counted and honored in revelation.
At forty the prayer asks gratitude for self and parents, work He approves, righteous offspring.

morning.en: Today's command comes with a memory - goodness to parents, and the hardship your mother bore for you.

night.en: A prayer fits this hour - my Lord, make me grateful for Your favor upon me and upon my parents.

gems.en: Guidance grows on guidance - each act of commitment opens the next depth of understanding.
You strive, He bestows - taqwa itself arrives as His gift to the sincere seeker.
Seeking brings guidance, guidance grows taqwa, taqwa deepens sight - each turn feeds the next.

morning.en: Steps toward Him compound today - those who are guided, He increases in guidance.

night.en: Whatever guidance you followed today was seed as well as gift - He increases those who are guided.

gems.en: Fa'lam - know it beyond opinion or inheritance: no deity except Allah, as settled certainty.
Even the Prophet was told to seek forgiveness - servitude at the summit, not admission of sin.
The Prophet was told to seek pardon for all believers - leadership carries its community's care.
He knows your movement and your resting place - awareness that comforts as it calls to account.

morning.en: The day's first knowledge is its greatest - no deity except Allah, held as certainty, not habit.

night.en: You rest tonight inside the verse's last clause - your resting place known, the believers prayed for.

gems.en: Tadabbur is not skimming - the Book expects mind and heart engaged, not recitation alone.
The locks the verse mentions are fitted from within - the barriers to truth are self-imposed.
For the unmoved hearer the verse leaves two explanations - no reflection, or a locked heart.
The key is named beside the lock - sincere contemplation is how the Qur'an opens its treasures.

morning.en: The Qur'an asks for more than your eyes today - tadabbur, the slow reflection that lets it in.

night.en: A locked heart is not a sentence - honest reflection tonight is the key the verse itself points to.

gems.en: Two obediences, one will - the Messenger carries and embodies what Allah commands.
Finished good deeds can still be unwritten - some sins drain the reward out of done work.
The warning is spoken to believers - faith is where the guarding of deeds begins, not ends.

morning.en: Today's good work is worth protecting - obedience builds it, and carelessness can quietly undo it.

night.en: Today's good deeds are banked, not sealed - obedience is what keeps them from being undone.

gems.en: Supporting Him takes many forms - truth carried, the oppressed defended, a day lived rightly.
The covenant is uneven in your favor - sincere effort is met by His overwhelming assistance.
What He plants is you - feet held firm, faith steady, courage intact when the ground shakes.

morning.en: Today's exchange is stated plainly - stand with His cause, and His support returns with firm footing.

night.en: If any part of today stood with His cause, the other half of the verse is His to keep - firm feet.

gems.en: Sakinah lands mid-trial, not after - peace inside turmoil, so that faith can keep growing.
Faith is added to faith - belief grows in layers, and no layer is the last one.
To Allah belong soldiers of the heavens and the earth - support beyond anything you can count.
Knowing and Wise - events around the believers are fully known and wisely arranged.

morning.en: Calm may arrive today as it did in this verse - sakinah, sent down by Him into believing hearts.

night.en: The calm that reached believing hearts came down, not up - sakinah was sent, and faith grew there.

gems.en: Faith made you kin - the believer beside you today is a brother before anything else divides.
Peacemaking between brothers is commanded, not offered - a nearby rift is a standing duty.
Taqwa here is practical - God-consciousness shows itself in the bonds you keep from breaking.
'That you may receive mercy' - mending between others opens the door to His mercy on you.

morning.en: The believers are but brothers - if a rift sits between two of yours today, mending it is your work.

night.en: If any bond was mended today, the verse's command was served - and His mercy is what it was tied to.

gems.en: The mocked may be better than the mocker - rank with Allah is hidden, so mockery is always blind.
Women mocking women is named on its own - dignity between women carries its own explicit guard.
Insults and ugly nicknames are forbidden - the verse guards names because words leave wounds.
For words already spoken, repentance stands open - refusing it is what fixes the wrong in place.

morning.en: No one is safely laughed at today - the one mocked may stand better than the mocker in Allah's sight.

night.en: If a word today mocked or wounded, the verse still holds the way back open tonight - repentance.

gems.en: Much assumption is to be avoided - some of it is sin, and unverified suspicion corrodes within.
What others keep private is not yours to uncover - the verse closes the door on spying.
Backbiting is shown its true face - eating a dead brother's flesh, a thing you would detest.
After naming these sins He names Himself Tawwab, Rahim - the passage ends in a door, not a verdict.

morning.en: Today carries three guards: less assumption, no prying, and no absent brother consumed in talk.

night.en: If suspicion or talk slipped today, the verse's close still stands - He is Accepting of repentance, Merciful.

gems.en: All of humanity descends from one male and one female - lineage marks origin, never worth.
Peoples and tribes exist for knowing one another - difference is an invitation, not a wall.
Nobility with Allah is measured by taqwa alone - every other ranking falls away before Him.
He is Knowing, Acquainted - each soul's true rank is His knowledge, not anyone's to assign.

morning.en: Everyone you meet today shares your origin - and the only rank Allah counts is taqwa.

night.en: Whatever rankings today ran on, one stands tonight: the most noble with Allah is the most God-conscious.

gems.en: The faith honored here settled past doubt - conviction steady enough to be built upon.
What genuine faith holds, it spends - wealth given in His path is belief made visible.
The striving includes the self - person and effort placed where the wealth already went.
'It is those who are the truthful' - the claim of faith is proven by what it has given.

morning.en: The verse defines the truthful: belief without wavering, then wealth and self given in His path.

night.en: By this verse the truthful are known not by words but by what they staked - faith, wealth, and self.

gems.en: The unreliable report is not ignored but checked - judgment waits for evidence before it moves.
Good intentions do not excuse acting on unverified claims - the innocent pay the cost of haste.
Regret is the verse's forecast for haste - remorse that verification would have prevented.

morning.en: Reports will reach you today - this verse sets a pause before belief, so ignorance harms no one.

night.en: Every claim you checked before acting today closed the road to the verse's ending - lasting regret.

gems.en: One soul began every lineage - the stranger passing you today is distant family by origin.
'Fear Allah and the wombs' - family bonds and the mothers who formed you carry sacred weight.
He is Raqib, the Ever-Watchful - how family rights are handled today does not go unseen.
The surah roots its social law in taqwa first - how you treat people begins with awareness of Him.

morning.en: Every person you meet today traces back with you to one soul - a kinship older than any difference.

night.en: Family and stranger alike today shared your origin - and the Observer saw how each one was met.

gems.en: Refuge for His sake is plural - not one narrow exit but many places of room and abundance.
Setting out toward Him secures the reward even if the journey is cut short - the first step counts.
'His reward falls upon Allah' is legal language - He has made your recompense a debt He will pay.
Past sins and half-ready plans do not disqualify you - mercy covers the one who set out sincerely.

morning.en: Whoever moves for His sake finds the earth has room - many refuges, and abundance besides.

night.en: If you set out for His sake today, the outcome is His to keep - Forgiving and Merciful at the road's end.

gems.en: Repentance is a practice, not an emergency exit - and His mercy outweighs His judgment.
Ghafoor and Raheem are not passing moods - forgiving is who He eternally is.
The Prophet sought forgiveness many times a day - asking often is the practice, not the failure.

morning.en: Seeking forgiveness is not a yearly event - it belongs inside an ordinary day like this one.

night.en: The verse's instruction fits the end of a day: seek His forgiveness - He is ever Forgiving, Merciful.

gems.en: Wrong against others and wrong against your own soul both have the same remedy: turning back to Him.
Thumma is sequence, not license: humans err, and the way back opens right after the error.
'Will find' is a promise, not a maybe - sincere seeking is guaranteed to meet His forgiveness ready.

morning.en: Whatever today brings, the door stands stated in advance: whoever seeks forgiveness finds Him Forgiving.

night.en: If today held a wrong, the verse's promise holds tonight: seek His forgiveness and you will find it.

gems.en: Wanting this world's reward aims too low - with Him, this world and the next come together.
He hears what you ask for and sees what you work for - your real aims are known to Him.
Worldly and spiritual were never rivals - His success reaches both realms at once.

morning.en: You do not have to choose between this life and the next today - with Him is the reward of both.

night.en: Whatever you worked for today, the fuller reward was always at one address: with Him, both worlds.

gems.en: Standing for justice is witness borne for Allah - even when the testimony points at your own self.
Rich or poor, He is closer to both than you are - neither wealth nor need may tilt your fairness.
The threat to your fairness is inward - hawa, the pull of preference, is what bends testimony.
Twisting the truth or withholding it are both seen - He is fully acquainted with what you do.

morning.en: Justice today may cost you something close - the verse asks for it even then, even against yourself.

night.en: If being fair cost you something today, it was not unnoticed - He is acquainted with what you do.

gems.en: Punishment is never His preference - it answers ingratitude, and gratitude removes its cause.
Gratitude and faith travel as a pair - together they are the response your day owes its Maker.
Shakir is one of His names - He appreciates your smallest good beyond what it deserves.
Your gratitude is never generic to Him - Alim means every detail of it is known and kept.

morning.en: He has no need to punish the grateful - thankfulness and faith are the whole of what today asks.

night.en: The thanks you offered today did not go unnoticed - He is Appreciative, and He is Knowing.

gems.en: Broadcasting faults pollutes more than it fixes - He does not love evil made loud.
If you have been wronged, your voice is protected - naming injustice aloud is your right.
Public or whispered, every word lands in His hearing - and He knows the intent behind it.

morning.en: Your words today can keep the air clean - public airing of evil is not something He loves.

night.en: Every word of this day was heard with its context - He is Hearing, and He is Knowing.

gems.en: Good shown can inspire; good hidden stays safe from show - the verse honors both ways of giving.
Overlooking an offense is divine mercy practiced at human scale.
Afuww is His name - not just forgiving a wrong but erasing it as if it never was.
His pardon comes from full power to do otherwise - mercy chosen from strength, never weakness.

morning.en: Pardoning an offense today puts you on His pattern - He is Ever-Pardoning, and pardons from power.

night.en: If you let an offense go today, you mirrored the strong kind of mercy - His pardon comes from power.

gems.en: Burhan means conclusive proof - your faith stands on evidence, not on wishful believing.
The Qur'an is called a clear light - the darkness of confusion is exactly what it was sent to lift.
The address is 'O mankind' - this light was never a private inheritance; it is offered to everyone.

morning.en: You are not walking into today unlit - a proof and a clear light have already been sent to you.

night.en: The light sent down does not set with the sun - the proof and the clear light stay yours tonight.

gems.en: Faith begins the connection; holding fast keeps it - i'tisam is belief with its grip closed.
Entry into His mercy is granted, not earned - rahma comes from Himself, by grace.
He adds bounty on top of mercy - fadl, giving past what justice alone would require.
The straight path here has a destination named: Himself. Guidance ends in His presence.

morning.en: Faith held with a firm grip is your part today - mercy, bounty, and the path to Him are His.

night.en: Holding fast through one more day - and the promise stands: mercy, bounty, and a path leading to Him.
