gems.en: Clarity is the stated purpose - He makes the lawful and unlawful plain, never a guessing game.
Guidance joins you to the practices of the righteous before you - a path with footprints in it.
His laws are exits from sin, not traps in it - the design keeps the way back to Him open.
Knowing and Wise - what He asks serves your welfare even where the reasons stay out of view.

morning.en: His guidance arrives with intent the verse spells out: to make things clear, to guide, to accept your return.

night.en: The day ran inside guidance built to be clear, walked by others before you, with the way back kept open.

gems.en: His first wish for you is stated outright: to accept your repentance and turn you toward growth.
Not every voice wants your steadiness - those led by their passions prefer company in the drift.
The deviation desired for you is called great - drifting with appetite is rarely a small detour.

morning.en: Allah wants to accept your return - that intention stands over today, whatever pulls the other way.

night.en: However today wavered, His wish tonight is unchanged: He wants to accept your return.

gems.en: Ease is built into what He asks - His laws are made to lighten, never designed to crush.
Your weakness is not news to Him - He made you, and He legislates for the human you actually are.
Concessions exist because He knows your limits - the easier path is mercy, not failure.

morning.en: He wants to lighten your load - not your hope talking, but the verse stating His intent toward you.

night.en: Whatever strength today drained, He knew your limits before you did - and He chose to lighten, not load.

gems.en: Everything begins at tawhid - worship kept for Him alone is the root the other duties grow from.
The verse draws circles around you - parents, kin, orphans, neighbors, travelers - each owed good.
Near neighbor and far neighbor are both named - proximity is not the boundary of your care.
The verse ends warning against arrogance - pride closes the hand that duty needs open.

morning.en: The verse orders the day: worship belonging to Him alone, then goodness flowing outward to kin and neighbor.

night.en: Worship of Him and goodness to those around you sat in one verse today - the near, the far, all inside it.

gems.en: Not an atom's weight of injustice touches His accounting - your smallest deed is weighed precisely.
One good deed never stays one with Him - it is multiplied, while sins are counted only as they are.
After the multiplying comes more - a great reward from Himself, generosity beyond what you earned.

morning.en: Nothing good you do today can be lost - He does not do injustice even by an atom's weight.

night.en: If any good passed through your hands today, it is already multiplied - and His gift comes on top.

gems.en: Returning what was entrusted to you is a command from Him, not a courtesy you may skip.
Wherever your word decides something for others today, fairness is part of the trust.
His instruction is called excellent by Him - what He asks of you is wisdom, not burden.
He hears the words you judge with and sees how you handle what was entrusted - all of it.

morning.en: Everything placed in your hands today - things, secrets, duties - is a trust with a rightful owner.

night.en: The trusts of this day - what you returned, what you judged - passed before One who hears and sees.

gems.en: Obedience has an address: with the prophets, the truthful, the martyrs, and the righteous.
Four different roads reach that company - truthfulness and steady good deeds are still open to you.
The verse pauses to admire them: excellent are those as companions. That is the promised circle.

morning.en: Obedience today is not a lonely road - it leads into the company of prophets and the righteous.

night.en: The obedience of this day was quietly choosing companions - and excellent are those as companions.

gems.en: Answering a greeting with a better one turns ordinary hellos into escalating kindness.
He legislated the small courtesies too - the details of how you greet people matter to Him.
Even a greeting sits in His account - nothing you exchange today is too small to be counted.

morning.en: Every greeting that reaches you today invites a better one back - kindness is meant to escalate.

night.en: The small courtesies you gave today were not lost - He is an Accountant over even a greeting.

gems.en: Every whisper of your soul is known to Him complete - nothing inward needs explaining first.
His nearness passes every measure - closer than the vein your own life runs through.
He created you and knows what He made - your dependence on Him is as old as your being.

morning.en: He is nearer to you than your own jugular vein - today begins with Him closer than anything in it.

night.en: The thoughts no one heard today were never hidden - He stayed nearer than your jugular vein through them all.

gems.en: Nothing said today is too small to be written - every utterance meets its record.
Raqib and atid - watchful and ready: the recording is constant, immediate, without delay.
Speech is watched word for word because words carry power - they build or break, heal or harm.

morning.en: Every word spoken today lands on a record - with each utterance stands an observer, prepared.

night.en: The day's words are delivered to their record now - what tomorrow's page holds is still unspoken.

gems.en: The heavens overhead are not an accident - they were constructed, deliberately, with strength.
'We are its expander' - the widening of the heavens sat in His word long before anyone measured it.
The strength that built the heavens does not tire or thin - the same power holds them today.

morning.en: The sky above you was built with strength - and He who raised it is, by His own word, its expander.

night.en: The heavens He built with strength are held wide tonight - the expanding is still His doing.

gems.en: Beneath every task today sits the purpose you were made for - all else the verse leaves secondary.
Ibadah is wider than prayer and fasting - honest work, kind words, and sincere intent all count.
Jinn and human alike were made for this one end - the purpose is shared by all who can choose.
He needs nothing from your worship - its gratitude, humility, and connection are gains only yours.

morning.en: One line settles today's purpose: jinn and mankind were created only to worship Him.

night.en: Whatever of today was done for Him served the purpose you were created for - the verse names no other.

gems.en: Ar-Razzaq provides continually - today's sustenance is a fresh giving, not a leftover.
His strength is matin - firm, needing no reinforcement; what rests on it does not shake.
Strong and firm together - power that carries joined to power that cannot be shaken.
You need provision and strength; He owns both without need - the dependence runs one way only.

morning.en: Today's provision has a named source - Ar-Razzaq, the continual Provider, firm possessor of strength.

night.en: You did not sustain yourself today - Ar-Razzaq did, from strength that never once thinned.

gems.en: Households that shared faith are, on His word, gathered together again in Paradise.
Children raised to their parents' rank there is pure grace - mercy beyond what was earned.
Every person is held to what he earned - the family mercy never erases the individual account.
'We will not deprive them of anything of their deeds' - parents lose no reward by the raising.

morning.en: For families who walk in faith together, a reunion is on record - descendants joined to believers.

night.en: A household kept on faith tonight leans toward that promise - such families joined again, nothing lost.

gems.en: Patience for His decision is commanded - delays sit inside His wisdom, not outside it.
'You are in Our eyes' steadied the Prophet under persecution - endurance for Him is not unseen.
The verse sets the day's opening act - tasbih with praise of your Lord when you arise.

morning.en: 'Be patient for the decision of your Lord' - the Prophet waited under eyes that never left him.

night.en: The command that carried the Prophet keeps its shape tonight - patience for His decision, under His watch.

gems.en: He Himself eased the Qur'an - its wisdom sits within reach of any seeker, schooled or not.
Made easy for dhikr - the Book's purpose is living remembrance of Him, not study alone.
The ease is granted; the verse then looks for a taker - receiving it is the part left to you.

morning.en: The Qur'an was made easy for remembrance by its Author - today it lies open to whoever will take it.

night.en: The eased Book kept its offer all day - a verse taken to heart tonight answers its call for a rememberer.

gems.en: The refrain returns thirty-one times - a rhythm set against how quickly favors are forgotten.
The address is dual - humans and jinn stand before the same call to recognize His favors.
No one can truthfully deny His favors - the question answers itself, and thanks is the answer.

morning.en: One refrain runs thirty-one times through the surah - today is lived among the favors it points to.

night.en: Count what today held and the refrain settles - none of His favors could honestly be denied.

gems.en: All that exists asks Him - your simply continuing today is a request He keeps answering.
He is no distant builder - every day He is bringing about a matter, present and active.
Healing, answering, turning the stars - countless affairs at once, and yours is among them.

morning.en: Everything in the heavens and earth asks Him - and every day He is at work. Today is no exception.

night.en: You may rest now - He remains as the verse says: every day bringing about a matter, tonight included.

gems.en: Ihsan is goodness done beautifully - past bare duty, into heartfelt excellence.
He answers beauty with beauty - what is done with ihsan returns as ihsan from Him.
The verse asks what excellence could earn but excellence - an answer too plain to argue.
It seals the surah's scenes of Paradise - after all the blessings, one rule: ihsan begets ihsan.

morning.en: One principle stands over today's work: the reward for excellence is nothing but excellence.

night.en: Whatever was done beautifully today rests under a settled rule - the reward for ihsan is ihsan.

gems.en: Tabaraka - His name itself is a spring of blessing that does not slow or run out.
Jalal holds you in awe while ikram draws you near - majesty and generous honor in one Lord.
After all the surah's listed favors, praise returns to one address - the Name they came from.
Majesty and generosity are not passing moods in Him - they are what He eternally is.

morning.en: The surah's last word fits the day's first - blessed is the name of your Lord, of Majesty and Honor.

night.en: The day ends where the surah ends - blessed is the name of your Lord, Owner of Majesty and Honor.

gems.en: Justice is established, not assumed - fairness in today's dealings takes deliberate care.
Correct form without honest fairness fails the verse - qist is equity meant, not performed.
Shortchanging in any form tips the balance - in trade and in dealings between people alike.

morning.en: 'Establish weight in justice' covers today whole - every measure, price, and judgment you touch.

night.en: Every scale you touched today - goods, judgments, words - sat under one command: do not tip it.

gems.en: Qard hasan - the All-Wealthy frames your charity as a loan made to Himself.
What you give He multiplies - with Allah the return outgrows the gift many times over.
Past the multiplying stands ajr karim - a reward noble in kind, not only large in measure.

morning.en: He asks who will lend Him a beautiful loan - whatever is given today is received by the All-Wealthy.

night.en: Anything lent to Him today sits in the safest keeping - multiplied, with a noble reward beside it.

gems.en: Charity here is a qard hasan - a goodly loan received by Allah, not money merely gone.
Yuda'afu - He multiplies the charitable act far beyond the sacrifice it cost.
Mussaddiqin and mussaddiqat - both named, men and women equal in agency and in reward.
Ajr karim - the recompense carries honor, dignity woven into the reward itself.

morning.en: The men who give and the women who give are named together - one goodly loan, one noble reward.

night.en: What any giver, man or woman, gave today stands recorded as a loan He has promised to multiply.

gems.en: Al-Awwal and al-Akhir - He precedes every beginning you make and outlasts every ending.
Az-Zahir and al-Batin - beyond all of creation, yet nearer than your own jugular vein.
Nothing in this day sat outside His knowledge - He is, of all things, Knowing.

morning.en: Before today existed He is the First; after it is forgotten, the Last - and He knows all it holds.

night.en: The day closes inside His names - First before it began, Last after it fades, Knowing all it carried.

gems.en: Mustakhlafin - the wealth you manage today is kept for Him, not owned outright.
Belief and spending arrive in a single breath - faith that is real reaches the hand.
For those who believe and spend, the return is fixed in the verse - a great reward.

morning.en: What fills your hands today is held in trust - belief and spending from it are one instruction.

night.en: Whatever left your hand for Him today was the trustee's true work - and its reward is written as great.

gems.en: A mountain would humble itself and crack under this Word - hearts are asked to be softer than stone.
Khashi'an - the mountain's humbling is total submission, the posture the Word deserves.
Mutasaddi'an - the Word can break apart what is hardest, ego and complacency included.
The parables are set out for reflection - each one an invitation to examine your own state.

morning.en: Had this Qur'an descended on a mountain, it would split from the fear of Allah - today it meets your heart.

night.en: The verse leaves its measure with you tonight - a Book that would have humbled and split a mountain.

gems.en: La ilaha illa Huwa - the verse opens on absolute unity; nothing else today is divine.
Ghayb and shahada both - what today hides and what it shows are equally known to Him.
Ar-Rahman - universal mercy that covers all creation in this world, whoever they are.
Ar-Rahim - the special mercy kept for believers in the Hereafter, deeper and everlasting.

morning.en: Today runs under one truth - no deity but He, Knower of unseen and seen, Rahman and Rahim.

night.en: Sleep falls inside His knowledge of unseen and seen - and beneath both mercies, Rahman and Rahim.

gems.en: Al-Malik - every authority you deal with today sits inside a dominion that is entirely His.
Name upon name stands in this one verse - many attributes, one Lord governing your whole day.
Al-Quddus, as-Salam - the One you lean on today carries no flaw, no need, no imperfection.
The verse ends by clearing His name - exalted above every partner people set beside Him.

morning.en: The day begins under His names - the Sovereign, the Pure, the Peace - one Lord, and none beside Him.

night.en: As-Salam - the night belongs to the Source of peace, exalted above all that was set beside Him.

gems.en: Al-Khaliq, al-Bari, al-Musawwir - three names tracing His making from design to finished detail.
Al-Asma al-Husna - every name of His is beautiful, and each one opens endless meaning.
Everything in the heavens and earth is exalting Him right now - your praise joins a full universe.
Al-Aziz, al-Hakim - the surah closes on might that only ever moves with perfect wisdom.

morning.en: Creator, Inventor, Fashioner - the day ahead was made by the One to whom the best names belong.

night.en: Creation's tasbih does not stop for the dark - the heavens and earth exalt Him while you rest.

gems.en: The Day will reward one habit above the noise: truth maintained through an ordinary life.
Truthfulness lived in passing years returns as gardens with rivers that never stop flowing.
'He is pleased with them, and they with Him' - satisfaction flowing both ways is the highest honor.
The great attainment is defined here - not worldly winning, but His pleasure held forever.

morning.en: Truth kept today is kept for you - a Day is coming when the truthful profit from their truthfulness.

night.en: The truth you kept today is the kind that benefits on the Day - and His pleasure stands at the end of it.

gems.en: Wasila is a means of nearness - and the Prophet and his family are the surest of those means.
Taqwa comes first in the verse - awareness of Him is the ground every other step stands on.
Striving includes the quiet battles - against ego, ignorance, and wrong - not only the loud ones.

morning.en: Three moves for today: taqwa, seeking the way of nearness to Him, and striving on His path.

night.en: Nearness sought, effort spent - the verse's ending is the point of it all: that you may succeed.

gems.en: No wrong is past the reach of tawba - sincere return with real repair reopens the door.
Regret alone is half of repentance - islah, actually setting things right, completes it.
When you turn back, He responds by turning to you - repentance is met, not merely permitted.

morning.en: Yesterday's wrong does not get the last word - repentance joined to repair opens His turning to you.

night.en: If you turned back and set something right today, His answer is already in the verse: He turns to you.

gems.en: The message had no optional parts - leaving one piece out would have left all of it undelivered.
'Allah will protect you from the people' - the announcement went out under divine guard.
At Ghadir Khumm the wilayah was declared - the one message the whole mission waited on.

morning.en: It is the day of Ghadeer - the Messenger was told: convey it, or the message is not conveyed.

night.en: Ghadeer closes: the message was delivered in full, under the protection He promised His Messenger.

gems.en: Standing firm for justice is done for Allah - not for applause, not for advantage, for Him.
Wherever your word affects someone's rights today, you are standing as a witness in justice.
Even the people you like least keep their claim on your fairness - dislike is no license.
Acting justly is itself an act of nearness - the verse ties fairness directly to taqwa.

morning.en: Someone may test your fairness today - the verse holds the line: no hatred may bend your justice.

night.en: If you stayed fair today toward someone you find hard to love, that was nearness to taqwa itself.

gems.en: The distance between you and an old adversary is not fixed - He can plant affection there.
No rift is too deep and no heart too hardened for Him - 'and Allah is able.'
His pardon reaches even former enemies who sincerely turn to Him - Forgiving and Merciful.

morning.en: 'Perhaps Allah will put affection' where there was enmity - carry that possibility into today.

night.en: If a strained tie weighed on you today, the verse ends the night: He is able, Forgiving, Merciful.

gems.en: Kindness and fairness to the peaceable are not concessions - Allah Himself permits them.
Birr - the word used for honoring parents - is the standard set for treating the peaceable.
'Allah loves those who act justly' - fairness earns His love, whoever is on the receiving end.

morning.en: Toward those who mean you no harm, the verse opens the door wide - be righteous with them, be just.

night.en: Where you dealt fairly today, the verse's close already applies - Allah loves those who act justly.

gems.en: Atoms and stars submit to His order without pause - deliberate worship joins what never stopped.
Sovereign, Pure, Mighty, Wise - the One all creation glorifies stands beyond every human limit.
Nothing in existence is purposeless - each part mirrors His majesty in its own way.

morning.en: The praise is already underway this morning - all in the heavens and earth exalts the Holy King.

night.en: The glorification never pauses for the night - creation keeps praising the Sovereign while you sleep.

gems.en: Prayer and the workday are not rivals here - one flows into the other at His command.
Today's earnings carry a higher name - fadl Allah, His bounty, sought at His own instruction.
Remembrance is not left behind at the mosque door - His name can thread the busiest hours.
'That you may succeed' - success is defined as worship, work, and much remembrance together.

morning.en: When prayer ends, the verse sends you out - seek His bounty, and keep His name with you as you work.

night.en: The verse's day is complete - prayer made, bounty sought, His name remembered through it all.

gems.en: This warning is addressed to believers - sincere faith does not make distraction impossible.
Wealth is not condemned here - its power to pull you from His remembrance is.
Children are blessings, yet even blessings can absorb the heart made for His remembrance.
Gaining the world while losing His remembrance is, in the verse's own word, loss.

morning.en: Wealth and children will ask for all of today - the verse asks that they not crowd out His remembrance.

night.en: The verse's measure holds at night - nothing gained today outweighs what losing His remembrance costs.

gems.en: No disaster arrives at random - everything passes through His permission first; chaos does not rule.
'Whoever believes in Allah - He will guide his heart' - steadiness inside the trial is His gift.
He knows every side of what tries you - including the purpose it is serving.

morning.en: Nothing can strike today outside His permission - and the believing heart travels under His guidance.

night.en: Whatever today carried came by His leave - and the heart that believes is guided through it, not around it.

gems.en: 'As much as you are able' - the command allows for your limits while asking sincere effort.
Listening is half - the verse joins hearing guidance to acting on it, knowledge to doing.
Giving is called good for your own soul - charity works on the giver first.
Greed is named a sickness of the soul - and protection from it is named success.

morning.en: 'Fear Allah as much as you are able' - He asks for your honest capacity today, not perfection.

night.en: He asked only what you were able - and the soul guarded from its greed is, by His word, successful.

gems.en: A goodly loan to Allah - spending for Him is the one loan whose return is guaranteed.
He does not repay giving one for one - He multiplies it, out of sheer generosity.
Charity carries a second gift in this verse - 'and He will forgive you.'
Shakur and Halim - He appreciates your smallest gift and bears patiently with your faults.

morning.en: Whatever you give today, the verse calls a loan to Allah - repaid multiplied, with forgiveness added.

night.en: What you gave for Him today is safely lent - He multiplies it, forgives you, and appreciates it.

gems.en: He provides from where you do not expect - your visible options are not His limits.
'He is sufficient for him' - not a helper alongside your plans, but enough by Himself.
Every difficulty has a set measure - what you carry now has a limit already decreed.
Allah accomplishes His purpose - whatever stands between, His command reaches its goal.

morning.en: Provision can reach you today from a direction you never planned - He is enough for whoever relies on Him.

night.en: Rest on the verse's two footholds - He suffices the one who relies, and all things are held to His measure.

gems.en: The wealthy spend from wealth, the pressed spend from what they have - each gift fits its giver.
'Allah does not charge a soul except what He has given it' - every duty fits a God-given capacity.
'After hardship, ease' is stated as His doing - the present tightness is not the final state.
Each gives according to means - fairness is built into giving so it crushes no one.

morning.en: Give today from whatever He has given you - He never charges a soul beyond what He supplied it.

night.en: If today was tight, sleep on the verse's ending - Allah will bring about, after hardship, ease.

gems.en: Her faith held beside the worst tyrant of her age - surroundings do not get to decide belief.
She lived in a palace and prayed for a house - because 'near You' outweighed everything in it.
Living close to wrongdoing, she actively asked His rescue - protection is something you seek.
'Build for me near You' - the heart of her prayer was His nearness, before Paradise itself.

morning.en: Allah Himself holds up Pharaoh's wife as an example - faith can stand firm inside the hardest house.

night.en: Her prayer is preserved for believers to keep praying - 'My Lord, build for me near You a house in Paradise.'

gems.en: Sincere repentance has two halves - real regret for what passed, firm resolve not to return to it.
'Perhaps your Lord will remove your misdeeds' - the 'perhaps' keeps you striving, not presuming.
For the sincerely returning, the verse holds out gardens with rivers flowing beneath.
That Day the Prophet and those who believed with him are not disgraced - their light runs out ahead.

morning.en: The day opens with an invitation to tawbatan nasuha - a sincere return that means not to go back.

night.en: Close the day with sincere return - and their prayer: 'Our Lord, perfect our light and forgive us.'

gems.en: From the smallest atom to the farthest galaxy, dominion rests in one hand - His.
'Over all things competent' - His power waits on no condition and depends on nothing.
Tabaraka, from baraka - He is the source every blessing in the day traces back to.

morning.en: Blessed is He in whose hand is the dominion - and today, with all its outcomes, sits in that hand.

night.en: The dominion did not change hands at sunset - blessed is He who holds it, tonight as this morning.

gems.en: The earth was tamed before you arrived - steady ground and breathable air are His arrangements.
Exploring the earth and earning from it are not detours from religion - the verse commands both.
However far you travel across His earth, the road's far end is the same - the return to Him.
Grown or bought, every bite traces back to 'His provision' - a gift renewed at every meal.

morning.en: The ground under you was made walkable on purpose - go out on it today and eat from His provision.

night.en: The tamed earth carried you today and His provision fed you - and to Him, the verse ends, is the return.

gems.en: Earthly gardens can be ruined overnight - the Gardens promised the righteous do not perish.
Taqwa is the named condition - awareness of Him that restrains wrong and moves the hand to give.
'With their Lord' - the heart of the promise is not scenery but nearness to Him.

morning.en: For the righteous there are Gardens of Pleasure with their Lord - a promise to walk toward all day.

night.en: The promise stands overnight - for the righteous, Gardens of Pleasure, kept with their Lord.

gems.en: The character Allah called great was made of patience, mercy, justice, and humility.
'Indeed you' - this is not human praise of the Prophet but Allah's own certain witness.
The Prophet embodied the Qur'an's guidance - the living example that it can be lived.

morning.en: Allah Himself testified to the Prophet's great character - the day's model of conduct is already set.

night.en: The testimony has not dimmed by night - the Prophet's character stands great, and stands as your example.

gems.en: The One you worship is not lost for being unseen - no eye was ever built to take Him in.
You cannot see Him, but you are never unseen - every glance you take today happens in His sight.
He is al-Latif - much of His kindness works at a fineness your senses were never made to catch.
He is al-Khabir - the hidden realities behind today's appearances are fully known to Him.

morning.en: You will not see Him today, but nothing of today escapes Him - the Subtle One works beneath what shows.

night.en: Your eyes missed most of today; His missed none of it. The Subtle, the Acquainted held every detail.

gems.en: Your rank is not assigned at random - it is built, deed by deed, from what you actually do.
No effort of yours today is background noise - He is never unaware of what you do.
Ranked degrees plus complete awareness leaves no gaps - nothing you do lands outside justice.

morning.en: Today adds to a rank that is earned, not issued - and your Lord is not unaware of what you do.

night.en: Whatever today's work amounted to, it was seen exactly - and degrees are given from what was done.

gems.en: His path is spoken of in the singular - one straight way, set against the many that lead off it.
The other paths do not just mislead - they scatter, pulling people from His way and from each other.
The straight path has a destination named in the verse: taqwa - walking it grows awareness of Him.

morning.en: Many ways will open today; the verse calls His path one - straight, and worth keeping your feet on.

night.en: If today pulled in many directions, the verse holds its line tonight: His path is one, and it is straight.

gems.en: Nothing of you sits outside the dedication - prayer, sacrifice, the whole of life, pointed one way.
Prayer and sacrifice are named first - worship is where devotion to Him alone becomes visible.
Your existence and its end are both for Him - no stretch of the span you are living is aimless.

morning.en: The verse gives today its direction: prayer, sacrifice, and living itself - all for the Lord of the worlds.

night.en: The day ends inside the dedication it began with: a life that belongs, all of it, to the Lord of the worlds.

gems.en: Rejection visited every messenger - being opposed is part of the road, not proof you left it.
Their sabr was active - they kept working under denial and harm, not merely waiting it out.
Help came to every patient messenger - His support is certain; only its hour is His to choose.
None can alter His words - the promise of support you lean on cannot be edited by anyone.

morning.en: Being denied does not mean you are failing - messengers before were denied, endured, and were helped.

night.en: If today brought denial, the old pattern still holds: the patient were carried through until help came.

gems.en: 'Peace be upon you' is the greeting He set for believers - safety spoken before anything else.
He obligated Himself to mercy - kataba, wrote it - so mercy is a commitment, not a mood.
Wrong done in ignorance, then repentance, then repair - the road back is mapped and open.
Ghafur removes the wrong; Rahim adds grace after it - restoration, not just cancellation.

morning.en: Before today asks anything of you, a decree is already in place: He has written mercy upon Himself.

night.en: Whatever went wrong out of ignorance today, the decree He wrote on Himself still reads: mercy.

gems.en: The keys of the unseen are His alone - what is hidden from you was never hidden, only held.
Land and sea, every place and creature - His knowledge has no uncovered corner.
Not a leaf falls unknown to Him - His attention reaches events the world calls insignificant.
Moist or dry, everything that exists sits written in a clear record - nothing goes unrecorded.

morning.en: Everything today that you cannot see coming is already known - the keys of the unseen are with Him.

night.en: Not a leaf fell today without His knowledge - and nothing of your day slipped past the clear record.

gems.en: Stars guided travelers before any compass - He provided for the human need to find the way.
The signs hang there for everyone - those who seek understanding are the ones they benefit.
Darknesses is plural - confusion takes many forms, and His guidance answers each of them.

morning.en: Guides were placed in the dark before you needed them - stars set so travelers could find the way.

night.en: The same sky over you tonight carried travelers home for centuries - guidance is how He provides.

gems.en: Every green thing you pass began as rain He sent - barren ground turned to abundance.
Sprout to layered grain, each stage is design at work - growth follows His arrangement.
Same soil, same water - grapes, olives, pomegranates. Diversity is His signature on sameness.
'Look' is a command in the verse - watching fruit form and ripen is an act of reflection.

morning.en: One water is behind everything green you pass today - rain sent down, and life brought out of it.

night.en: The fruit ripening somewhere in the dark tonight is a sign still working - for a people who believe.

gems.en: Beautiful patience endures without complaint - grace and dignity kept through the hard part.
The Prophet was consoled directly - his task was patience; the mockers' account was Allah's.
'Beautiful' makes patience active - it settles your character and quietly reaches those near you.

morning.en: 'Be patient with beautiful patience' - the counsel the Prophet received sets the tone for today.

night.en: If today asked for endurance, close it as the verse asks - patience kept beautiful, free of complaint.

gems.en: Tawhid is meant to be said aloud - the command was to declare it, not only to hold it inside.
Worship, supplication, and final reliance all travel one direction - to Him, without partners.
Under pressure to compromise, the Prophet's answer is the template - I only invoke my Lord.

morning.en: The Prophet's declaration is a model for yours - I call on my Lord, and set no partner beside Him.

night.en: The day ends where the verse begins - calling on your Lord alone, with no one set beside Him.

gems.en: Remembrance of His name belongs inside your activities, not only in the pauses between them.
Tabattul is a clean break - for a while, everything else set down, and only Him.
His 'name' opens onto all His names - each one another aspect of Him to sit with.
Worship is weighed by presence - the heart's attendance counts, not the motions alone.

morning.en: Carry the name of your Lord through everything today - and keep one stretch of it for Him alone.

night.en: The quiet after Isha is made for tabattul - the day set down, and nothing attached but Him.

gems.en: East, west, and everything between belong to Him - nothing you cross today lies outside His domain.
'There is no deity except Him' - the creed stands whole, leaving no rival claim on your reliance.
A wakil is trusted with what you hand over - the verse invites you to hand your affairs to Him.

morning.en: Lord of the east and the west - wherever today moves, take Him as the keeper of your affairs.

night.en: What is unfinished tonight has a Disposer - leave your affairs with the Lord of the east and the west.

gems.en: Effort itself is appreciated, not outcomes alone - the sincere intention inside the deed has worth.
His reward outruns the deed - finite effort met with generosity beyond its measure.
In Shia understanding, recognizing the Ahlul Bayt raises the worth of the deeds a believer brings.

morning.en: On record for the people of Paradise: 'your effort has been appreciated' - He does not overlook striving.

night.en: The greeting stands on record - 'your effort has been appreciated' - striving for Him is never wasted.

gems.en: Dhikr at both ends of the day traces a deeper crossing - out of neglect's night, into His light.
Morning and evening here are read as the set prayers - Fajr, then Maghrib and Isha, framing the day.
In Shia commentary, His name is known through His proofs - the Imams who carry His guidance.

morning.en: The day is framed at both ends by one instruction: mention the name of your Lord, morning and evening.

night.en: The evening mention is due now - the day that opened with His name closes with it.

gems.en: Night is when nearness opens - distractions thin, and qiyam al-layl draws you close to Him.
Sujud makes submission physical - in Shia understanding, whole lives align under His guardianship.
The long night asked for is measured in depth - unhurried devotion, not counted minutes.

morning.en: Part of tonight already has a claim on it: prostration to Him, and long glorifying in the dark.

night.en: The verse's hour has arrived - some of this night belongs to sujud and long tasbih before Him.

gems.en: 'In spite of love for it' - real giving parts with what you still want, not what you were done with.
The verse names three - the needy, the orphan, the captive - vulnerability in its different forms.
Feeding someone meets the most immediate human need - righteousness that begins with hunger.

morning.en: It is the day of Surah al-Insan - food given out of love for Him to the needy, the orphan, the captive.

night.en: The day of al-Insan closes on its example - cherished food handed over, out of love for Him.

gems.en: Musa's counsel under oppression was not a tactic - it was Allah's help, sought before all else.
The sabr Musa commanded was not resignation - endure actively, and leave the timing to Him.
Every power that looms today is a tenant - the earth is Allah's, and He assigns its inheritance.
The ending is already assigned - the best outcome belongs to those who keep their taqwa intact.

morning.en: Musa's counsel still fits a hard day: seek help through Allah, hold on - the outcome is for the righteous.

night.en: Whatever loomed today, Musa's words hold tonight: the earth is Allah's, and the outcome is for the righteous.

gems.en: Guidance did not end with the prophets - a community that guides by truth is always in the world.
What guides must be true, not merely popular - opinion and custom cannot stand in for haqq.
Justice is not a separate project - where truth is genuinely followed, fairness follows from it.
That guiding community is no accident of history - He created it, deliberately, as part of His plan.

morning.en: Somewhere in the world today a community guides by truth and judges by it - and you can stand with them.

night.en: The verse outlasts the day: among what He created there is a people guiding by truth, judging by it.

gems.en: Every other protection can be bought off or worn down - the Prophet's answer was one word: Allah.
Your Protector is the Book's Sender - His guarding and His guidance come from the same hand.
He takes charge of the righteous - faith lived, not merely named, is what draws His special care.

morning.en: The Prophet's answer to every threat can open your day too: my protector is Allah, who sent down the Book.

night.en: Sleep comes easier inside the Prophet's sentence: my protector is Allah - and He is ally to the righteous.

gems.en: What people offer freely, accepted without demanding more - that is the verse's first command.
Goodness is not only practiced but urged - promoting what is right is part of carrying this faith.
Not every argument deserves you - turning from entrenched mockery is wisdom, not weakness.
Gentleness, moral courage, knowing when to walk away - one verse holds the Prophet's character.

morning.en: One verse can run a whole day: take what comes easily, urge what is good, turn from the ignorant.

night.en: Tonight's measure is one verse: what you accepted with ease, the good you urged, the arguments you left.

gems.en: Dhikr counts before it is audible - remembrance living inside you is the kind the verse asks for.
Casual mention is not remembrance - dhikr carries humility and awe of the One being remembered.
Remembrance does not need volume - kept below the level of show, sincerity holds full strength.
Morning and evening are dhikr's set hours - the day is meant to be framed by Him at both ends.

morning.en: The verse gives this hour a purpose - morning is one of the appointed times to remember your Lord within.

night.en: The evening remembrance the verse prescribed belongs to now - quiet dhikr within, and the day is framed.

gems.en: Nearness to Him has a known cause - those closest to Him are there by worship that never tires.
Their height never made the angels proud - closeness to Him deepens humility, never excuses it.
Praise on the tongue, forehead on the ground - tasbih and sujud together are worship in full.
Al-A'raf ends with a sajdah mark - an invitation to join, in your body, the worship of the heavens.

morning.en: The ones nearest your Lord are worshiping right now, without a trace of pride - today's prayers join theirs.

night.en: The angels have not paused since your day began - glorifying, prostrating - and your sujud kept their company.

gems.en: Adam's prayer is the template: admit the wrong, ask forgiveness, ask for mercy - in that order.
'We have wronged ourselves' - sin's first casualty is your own soul, and honest return says so.
Even Adam did not lean on his record - 'if You do not forgive us' rests everything on His mercy.
Satan blamed and persisted; Adam and his wife turned back at once - the response decided everything.

morning.en: Whatever yesterday held, Adam's words are yours this morning: our Lord, we have wronged ourselves.

night.en: Adam's words fit the close of a day: we have wronged ourselves - forgive us, have mercy, or we are lost.

gems.en: Creation took six stages on purpose - His power moves through deliberate order, never haste.
Established above the Throne means over it all - nothing today happens outside His permission.
Night is chasing the day right now, as it always has - the schedule you live inside is His.
Sun, moon, and stars have never once rebelled - the cosmos you woke under runs on obedience.

morning.en: Today opens inside a cosmos that obeys - sun, moon, and stars all subjected by His command.

night.en: The night arriving now chased the day down exactly on schedule - His is the creation and the command.

gems.en: Prayer asks for two things the verse names: real humility, and privacy that keeps it pure.
Asking is welcome; demanding is not - supplication keeps its manners even at its most urgent.
What you ask Him in secret stays clean - no audience, no performing, just you and Him.

morning.en: The door for today's needs opens a particular way: humbly, and in private - that is how He asked to be called.

night.en: This hour is the verse's own setting - humble, private words to Him fit the night exactly.

gems.en: The order around you, natural and moral, was set right by Him - your part is not to break it.
Fear and hope are not rivals in prayer - together they hold off despair and presumption both.
His mercy is not far and hard to reach - the verse places it near, beside the doers of good.

morning.en: One measurement stands over today: the mercy of Allah is near to those who do good.

night.en: Whatever good you did today placed you where the verse says mercy sits - near, beside the doers of good.

gems.en: Kadh is toil of every kind - and all of it, for good or ill, is carrying you toward your Lord.
'O mankind' cuts through the crowd - the road of toil you travel toward Him is personally yours.
Fa-mulaqihi leaves no doubt - every effort ends in a meeting, and you will see what yours earned.
Every path, chosen knowingly or not, runs one direction - toward the Lord who created you.

morning.en: Today's exertion is not aimless - you are laboring toward your Lord, and the road ends at a meeting.

night.en: The day's toil is done; each such day of labor draws the meeting with your Lord one stage nearer.

gems.en: Sabbih is a clearing away - declaring Him free of every flaw thought or speech could pin on Him.
'Your Lord' keeps glory personal - the Most High is not distant but nurturing your growth Himself.
Al-A'la admits no rival - no power or rank in creation stands anywhere near His height.

morning.en: The surah's opening claims the morning first: exalt the name of your Lord, the Most High.

night.en: Above everything the day held, He remains the Most High - the last word tonight is His glory.

gems.en: Qad aflaha is a verdict already given - the purified one's success is declared by Allah Himself.
Tazakka is work done on yourself - purification is chosen and carried out, not merely received.
Tazkiyah runs the whole depth - creed cleared of shirk, the heart of envy, the day's acts of sin.

morning.en: Eid al-Fitr dawns on the verse's verdict: he has succeeded who purified himself - a month's work crowned.

night.en: Eid's night settles on the verse's verdict - the purified soul, and success declared by Him.

gems.en: Ease toward ease - the doubling declares His intent: faith is meant to be borne, not to crush.
Nuyassiru is active - the way is being smoothed from His side; the striving is not carried alone.
Al-yusra, the ease itself, is read as the deen - a path cut to fit the nature you were made with.

morning.en: The promise sent to the Prophet points the day's way: toward ease, by a Lord who Himself makes it easy.

night.en: The day closes inside His stated intent - a faith made easy to carry, ease leading on to ease.

gems.en: Irji'i - return - death is worded as homecoming, back to the Lord you began from.
Radiyah and mardiyyah - a soul content with His decree, and a Lord pleased with that soul's deeds.
Contentment is both done and given - the soul accepts, and grace has been shaping it all along.

morning.en: The soul at rest will hear these words: return to your Lord, content and welcomed - the day can point there.

night.en: The gentlest summons on record ends the day's reading: return to your Lord, well-pleased and pleasing.

gems.en: If His mention moves something in you, that is not fragility - awe is how living faith responds.
Faith is not a fixed quantity - every verse truly received can leave you with more than you had.
Tawakkul is effort given in full with the outcome handed to Him - active trust, not fatalism.

morning.en: Faith shows today in responses: a heart that stirs at His name, and your full weight rested on Him.

night.en: If any verse truly reached you today, your faith ends the day larger - that is how believers grow.

gems.en: The call of Allah and His Messenger is not a demand on your life - it is the offer of a truer one.
Your heart is closer to Him than to you - He can open it, turn it, hold it. That power is His.
Every answer you give the call travels forward - to Him you will be gathered, choices and all.

morning.en: The call standing over today is an offer of life - answering Allah and His Messenger is how it is taken.

night.en: Tonight your heart rests with the One who stands between it and you - and to Him is the gathering.

gems.en: Where you stand now was not always so - He has moved His people from few and afraid to sheltered.
The shelter and the victories were His doing - your own planning was never what held you up.
The good things in your hands are in the verse - provision from Him, part of His favor to you.
Shelter, support, provision - all of it aims at one response: that you might be grateful.

morning.en: Today has a backstory the verse tells: once few and afraid, then sheltered, supported, provided for.

night.en: The day closes on the verse's ledger: sheltered, supported, provided for - and thanks is what it was for.

gems.en: Discernment is given, not achieved - taqwa is answered with furqan, a criterion for true and false.
Taqwa works backward too - misdeeds already on the record are removed as awareness of Him holds.
Beyond erasing the misdeed, He forgives you - the person is pardoned, not just the record cleared.
The exchange is tilted in your favor - He is the possessor of great bounty, giving past deserving.

morning.en: Taqwa today carries a promise: a criterion to see clearly, misdeeds removed, forgiveness on top.

night.en: If taqwa was kept anywhere today, its returns are named: clearer sight, wrongs erased, pardon granted.

gems.en: Strength has a structure: obedience to Allah and His Messenger, and no quarrels inside the ranks.
Patience is not waiting - it is standing steady, and it earns company: Allah is with the patient.
Quarreling costs more than the argument - the verse says your wind departs, the momentum itself.

morning.en: Today's strength is kept or lost in one place: no quarreling, and patience - He is with the patient.

night.en: Where you refused to quarrel and chose patience today, your strength stayed - and He stayed with you.

gems.en: Sufficiency was never in the numbers - Allah's backing alone was declared enough for His Prophet.
The 'enough' extends - those who truly follow the Prophet stand inside the same sufficiency.
At the hardest hour, Allah addressed His Prophet with comfort directly - reassurance is His way.

morning.en: However the odds stack today, the count is short: Allah suffices His Prophet, and those who follow him.

night.en: The line that held the Prophet steady closes the day: Allah is sufficient for him and for those who follow.

gems.en: Kabad names the human condition - struggle is not an interruption of life but the substance of it.
'We created' - toil was designed in, not left to chance; struggle carries His purpose and wisdom.
Laqad seals it - that life involves struggle is stated as certainty, so no one meets it surprised.

morning.en: Difficulty today is not a sign something went wrong - man, the verse says plainly, was created into toil.

night.en: Today's share of kabad has been carried - struggle was written into the design, and you bore yours.

gems.en: Guiding is His own charge - prophets, scripture, and fitrah all sent so the way can be found.
'Upon Us' - guiding is a duty He took on Himself, chosen by His mercy, not earned by anyone.
Al-huda takes the definite article - the guidance: one true way, marked out by revelation.

morning.en: Whatever today asks you to find, the finding of the way is His declared charge: upon Us is the guidance.

night.en: If any hour today felt directionless, the pledge holds through the night: guidance is upon Him to give.

gems.en: The one who asks is owed regard - whether the request is bread or understanding, asking is no fault.
Tanhar is the rough refusal - even a no, when you cannot give, must be spoken gently.
Sa'il covers hands and minds alike - the beggar and the questioner are both owed a gentle reception.

morning.en: Someone will ask something of you today - the verse has already ruled on the tone: do not repel them.

night.en: Tally the day's requests - the verse asked only that none who came asking was driven off harshly.

gems.en: Speaking of His favor is not boasting - hiding a blessing in false modesty is what this corrects.
Haddith means to recount - His care for you, told so that someone else takes heart.
The surah's close rounds its arc - blessings remembered, gratitude acted, and thanks finally spoken.
For the Prophet the command was mission itself - the favor to proclaim was revelation for all.

morning.en: Today holds the surah's last command: some favor of your Lord, spoken of - a blessing named is thanks begun.

night.en: Before sleep, the verse's last command is easy to keep - name one favor of your Lord from this day.

gems.en: The verse answered the Prophet's fear in a pause of revelation - silence never meant abandonment.
Wadda'a means a parting farewell - the word He denies; apparent silence is not departure.
Qala means displeasure - denied outright; a quiet stretch does not signal His anger.

morning.en: Spoken first to His Prophet, the reassurance was sent to be heard: quiet from heaven is not abandonment.

night.en: The comfort sent for the Prophet holds its shape tonight: silence from heaven was never abandonment.

gems.en: The word to the Prophet points the direction of things - the later outweighs what strains now.
Read two ways: the Prophet's later years over his hard early ones, and the eternal over it all.
The first-and-later comparison carries a principle - a believer's road climbs toward greater good.

morning.en: Assured to the Prophet in hard days, the direction holds: what is ahead is better than what has been.

night.en: Another day of the first life ends - and the Hereafter, the Prophet was assured, is better than it.

gems.en: The promise to the Prophet has no ceiling - his Lord will give until he is fully content.
La-sawfa doubles the emphasis - this giving is decreed, not merely possible.
Tarda is the promise's end point - not gifts alone, but a contentment nothing is missing from.

morning.en: The day opens on a promise made to the Prophet: his Lord will give until he is satisfied - such is the Giver.

night.en: The promise stays with the Prophet; the Giver it reveals is your Lord too - His giving aims at contentment.

gems.en: The command reaches back - He sheltered His Prophet as an orphan, then charged him to shelter them.
Taqhar means to crush or subdue - not neglect alone but every harshness toward the powerless.
The 'so' carries the logic - shelter received obliges shelter given; his orphanhood set the pattern.

morning.en: Among the day's plain commands stands this: the orphan is not to be crushed - the weak are owed gentleness.

night.en: A day ends well when this charge was kept - the weak handled gently, no orphan crushed.

gems.en: The promise is issued twice in a row - repetition is His emphasis, certainty stated and restated.
When despair insists a hardship is permanent, there are two identical assurances to answer it.
One same hardship named twice, ease left indefinite - scholars read one trial, several eases.

morning.en: Carry the doubled promise into the day: with hardship, ease - said twice so it cannot be doubted.

night.en: However hard the day sat, the doubled promise holds - the one hardship, and ease alongside it.

gems.en: Faraghta marks a completion - when duty is done, devotion is what the freed hours are for.
Fansab asks for exertion - worship offered with effort, not the leftovers of a tired evening.
Work, then worship, then work again - the verse sets a rhythm where all of it is service to Him.

morning.en: The day's tasks come with a sequel - when one work is finished, the verse appoints the next: stand for Him.

night.en: If the day's work is finished, the verse's moment is now - what follows completion is devotion.

gems.en: Ahsan taqwim covers all of you - frame, mind, and the capacity for Him, each given in balance.
Taqwim is a craftsman's word - proportion and balance, a making measured with intent.
The finest form is a starting point - built into it is the reach toward excellence and toward Him.

morning.en: The day begins from the Qur'an's estimate of the human: created in the best of stature, by His design.

night.en: Rest tonight in a making the Qur'an calls the finest of forms - His own assessment of His work.

gems.en: Every verdict from Him comes from ahkam al-hakimin - fairness has no higher court than His.
The question is asked so the answer can only be yes - a truth no honest reasoning can refuse.
His judgment holds what no human court does - complete knowledge, pure justice, and wisdom entire.
Reciters traditionally answer aloud: indeed, and I am of those who bear witness to that.

morning.en: The surah closes on a question with one answer - Allah is the most just of judges, whatever today misjudges.

night.en: Take the day's unsettled verdicts to the answer - He is the most just of judges, and nothing escaped Him.

gems.en: Iqra' came first - revelation opened with a command to read, setting knowledge at the foundation.
Learning begins 'in the name of your Lord' - knowledge is sanctified by naming its true source.
The Lord who commands reading is the One who created - creation, read closely, shows its Maker.

morning.en: On Mab'ath the first revealed word returns to its day: iqra' - read, in the name of your Lord who created.

night.en: Mab'ath ends - the day that honors revelation's first word, iqra', and all the guidance that followed.

gems.en: Anzalna settles the Qur'an's origin - sent down from Him, a gift given, not a book composed.
Laylat al-Qadr is when destinies are set down and mercy pours - the night the Qur'an came down in.
'We sent it down' - the plural of majesty; the Sovereign Himself stands behind the sending.

morning.en: Laylat al-Qadr arrives with this day - the night of the Qur'an's descent, when mercy overflows.

night.en: This is the night itself - the Qur'an descended in hours like these, and destinies are being written.

gems.en: No good is below the scale's notice - an atom's weight registers, and His accounting keeps it.
You will not just be told of your good - you will see it, perhaps as beauty, perhaps as light.
Khayr is a wide gate - worship, charity, fairness, kindness, patience: all of it weighs in.
'Whoever' holds no exceptions - rank, race, and station vanish where His justice weighs the good.

morning.en: Nothing good today will be too small to count - an atom's weight is enough to be seen again.

night.en: Every small good the day held is safe - not one atom's weight of it is lost, and you will see it.

gems.en: Charity is hygiene for the soul - what leaves your hand takes some of the heart's residue along.
Giving runs against arithmetic - wealth given grows, in barakah outside and in purity within.
The givers received the Prophet's prayer - and his prayer, the verse says, is rest for their souls.
He hears the prayer over your gift and knows the intention in it - reward follows the full truth.

morning.en: What you give today does double work the verse describes: it purifies you, and it makes you grow.

night.en: If charity left your hands today, it did not simply leave - it purified, and set growth in motion.

gems.en: Sincere tawba is never left pending - no matter the sin, acceptance is already His stated way.
Charity never stops at the receiving hand - He Himself takes it. Giving today is divine encounter.
At-Tawwab accepts those who return again and again - repeat returns are what His name promises.

morning.en: Today opens on a settled fact: it is Allah Himself who accepts repentance from His servants.

night.en: If tonight holds regret, the verse has answered in advance: He is the Accepting of repentance, the Merciful.

gems.en: Turning back is completed in deeds, not declarations - today's work is where tawba becomes real.
He sees the work nobody else notices - and that watching is what keeps private effort sincere.
Your deeds are witnessed by the Messenger and the believers - transformation has its testifiers.
The final report goes to the Knower of the unseen and witnessed - hidden intentions included.

morning.en: The day's command is a single word: work. What you do today rises into the sight of Allah.

night.en: Nothing you worked at today went unwitnessed - Allah saw it, and so did His Messenger and the believers.

gems.en: Taqwa is not terror - it is moving through the day aware that He is present in every action.
'Be with the truthful' makes companionship a command - who you stand with shapes who you become.
God-consciousness within and good company around come as one instruction - each guards the other.

morning.en: Two commands shape today: keep taqwa of Allah, and keep the truthful within your company.

night.en: The day ends where it began: with Him held in awareness, and the truthful counted as your people.

gems.en: Guidance arrived through one who shared your language and your struggles - it was made reachable.
Your suffering lands on the Prophet as his own pain - true leadership carries its people's burdens.
He is concerned over you - the Prophet's care presses toward your good and does not give up.
To believers he is kind and merciful - firm in truth, gentle with every sincere mistake.

morning.en: A Messenger came to you from among yourselves - and what you suffer is grievous to him.

night.en: The day closes under the verse's portrait: a Messenger grieved by your hardship, kind and merciful to you.

gems.en: 'Light or heavy' covers you either way - He calls you as you are, not as your best self someday.
Wealth and self together - faith asks for the whole of you, not a compartment kept convenient.
What the effort costs is not what it is - the verse calls it better for you, if you only knew.

morning.en: Light or heavy - the call does not wait for an easier day; it meets you as you are.

night.en: Whatever you gave today - means, energy, self - the verse holds its verdict: that was better for you.

gems.en: Nothing strikes you except what He decreed for you - and His decree passed through wisdom first.
'He is our Mawla' - not a distant deity but a guardian, actively keeping those who trust Him.
Reliance on Him is not an advanced elective - the verse makes tawakkul the believers' baseline.

morning.en: Today can only bring what He has written for you - and the One who wrote it is your protector.

night.en: Everything that struck or spared you today was His decree - and He was your Mawla through all of it.

gems.en: Rivers under gardens - the promised scene is everything today's scarcity and struggle are not.
The dwellings promised do not age or wear or end - pleasant homes, in gardens of permanence.
Above every river and dwelling stands the larger prize - His approval, greater than the garden.
The verse defines supreme success - not a worldly win, but Paradise with His pleasure over it.

morning.en: Believing men and women hold one promise today: gardens, homes that last - and His approval, greater still.

night.en: Whatever today lacked, the promise stands tonight: gardens, lasting homes, and His approval above them.
